jobs.title: Mental Health Program Specialist 2, Central Office;
jobs.description:
Duties Description The New York State Office of Mental Health (OMH) is currently recruiting to fill Mental Health Program Specialist 2, Grade 23, positions in the New York City Field Office. The incumbents will be assigned to the Licensing/Certification Unit within the Field Office and, based on assignments, will be required to travel. Specific duties to be performed may include, but are not limited to, the following:
  
  
Conduct on-site reviews of licensed mental health programs including inpatient, outpatient and community residential facilities to determine compliance with OMH regulations and Standards of Care.
  
  
Prepare final recommendations and written reports for renewal of program’s certification and the issuance of an operating certificate.
  
  
Collaborate with other units within the OMH Field Office and staff of OMH Central Office on completing licensing and recertification tasks, monitoring of programs and ensuring adequate follow up, as well as review and monitoring of program’s Performance Improvement Plan.
  
  
Interpret OMH policy as it applies to specific situations involving State and local providers and provide technical assistance to programs licensed by OMH.
  
  
Participate in review of Prior Approval Review applications, Administrative Actions, and Request for Proposals, as appropriate.
  
  
Participate in special projects as assigned, as well as system transformation initiatives.

Minimum Qualifications Non-Competitive Minimum Qualifications Under the NY HELPS Program:
  
To be eligible for appointment, candidates must have a bachelor's degree in child and family studies, counseling and community psychology, creative arts therapy, criminal justice, health administration, hospital administration, marriage and family therapy, mental health counseling, nursing, psychoanalysis, psychology, public administration, public health, public policy, recreation therapy, rehabilitation counseling, social work, sociology, or special education AND three years of professional clinical or administrative experience in a federal or state operated, licensed, certified, or funded mental health program.
  
  
A master's degree in child and family studies, counseling and community psychology, creative arts therapy, criminal justice, health administration, hospital administration, marriage and family therapy, mental health counseling, nursing, psychoanalysis, psychology, public administration, public health, public policy, recreation therapy, rehabilitation counseling, social work, sociology, or special education can subsitute for one year of specialized experience.
  
  
Transfer Opportunity:
  
Candidates must have one year of permanent competitive or 55b/c service as a Mental Health Program Specialist 2, G-23, and be eligible for lateral transfer; OR be eligible to transfer via Section 70.1 of the Civil Service Law by having one year of permanent competitive or 55b/c service in a qualifying title within two salary grades or one M-grade of the Grade 23 level.
  
  
55b/c Opportunity:
  
Individuals certified eligible for the 55b/c program under the Governor’s Program to Hire Persons/Veterans with Disabilities pursuant to Section 55b/c of the Civil Service Law will also be considered. In addition to a current 55b/c eligibility letter, candidates must possess a Bachelor's or higher degree in child and family studies, counseling and community psychology, creative arts therapy, criminal justice, health administration, hospital administration, marriage and family therapy, mental health counseling, nursing, psychoanalysis, psychology, public administration, public health, public policy, recreation therapy, rehabilitation counseling, social work, sociology, or special education AND three years of professional clinical or administrative experience in a mental health program. Please provide a copy of your eligibility letter with your application.

Additional Comments Specific scheduled hours and telecommuting availability for this position will be discussed during the interview process. Please note, employees are required to apply and obtain approval through management to telecommute according to operational needs and Agency Telecommuting Program Guidelines.
  
  
The Mission of the New York State Office of Mental Health is to promote the mental health of all New Yorkers, with a focus on providing hope and supporting recovery for adults with serious mental illness and children with serious emotional disturbances. Applicants with lived mental health experience are encouraged to apply. OMH is deeply committed to supporting underserved individuals, organizations, and communities. To this end, OMH is focused on implementing activities and initiatives to reduce disparities in access, quality, and treatment outcomes for underserved populations. A critical component of these efforts is ensuring OMH is a diverse and inclusive workplace where all employees' unique attributes and skills are valued and utilized to support the mission of the Agency. OMH is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer.
  
  
This title is part of the New York Hiring for Emergency Limited Placement Statewide Program (NY HELPS).

Some positions may require additional credentials or a background check to verify your identity.

jobs.title: Graduate Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
Graduate Program Coordinator

**Required Qualifications (as evidenced by an attached resume):**  
Bachelor's Degree (foreign equivalent or higher). Two (2) years of full-time administrative experience in a college or university setting. Proficiency with Microsoft Office and Google Workspace applications.  
  
**Preferred Qualifications:**  
Master's Degree (foreign equivalent or higher). Three (3) or more years of full-time administrative experience working with graduate and/or undergraduate students and faculty in a university setting. Demonstrated experience supporting graduate admissions, student services, or academic program coordination. Familiarity with graduate arts programs, MFA programs, or other graduate-level academic environments. Evidence of tracking progress using multiple data sets and systems with adherence to governing policies. Experience with any of the following campus systems: Slate, PeopleSoft, DegreeWorks, Navigate, SBU Reporting, Concur, Zoom, Modern Campus CMS, Canva. Knowledge of SUNY Graduate School policies and procedures, including GTA contracts and funding packages. Experience supervising Graduate Assistants or Teaching Assistants. Experience managing delegated email inboxes and composing clear, timely responses to student, faculty, and public queries. Experience with website content management systems. Experience with event planning, logistics coordination, or AV/technology support.  
  
**Brief Description of Duties:**  
The Graduate Program Coordinator provides administrative support for three MFA programs in Creative Writing, in Film, and in Television Writing at the Manhattan Center. The Graduate Program Coordinator will coordinate all aspects of graduate admissions and recruiting; support program directors, faculty, and current students; advise and track students through degree completion; and manage on-site events and logistics. The successful candidate will have excellent written and verbal communication skills, the ability to work independently and collaboratively across multiple programs, and demonstrated comfort with university administrative systems and technology. The position requires methodically managing multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced environment with attention to detail. Position requires flexibility in supporting underlying academic programs.

* Graduate Recruitment and Admissions:

  + Assist Admissions Committees and MFA Directors with recruiting and admitting new students to the Manhattan Center and other locations. Work with MFA Directors and Marketing & Communications to place and monitor marketing campaigns, printed materials, social media, and other advertising; report on campaign results.
  + Coordinate recruiting events including open houses, information sessions, and virtual activities. Working with other professionals and multiple systems track submission materials, confirm status with appropriate committees, compile files, and update committees and the Graduate School on new admits, declines, and deferrals.
  + Proactively communicate with applicants, admitted students, students on leave, and deferrals as well as respond to queries. Capture and track data from inquiries, open houses, decision letters, admissions response forms, informational packets, and other communications in compliance with Graduate School guidelines.
  + Track Graduate Assistant lines awarded, Graduate Tuition scholarships, and all other scholarships and awards from offer letters. Serve as the primary liaison between the graduate programs and the Graduate School. Develop expertise in PeopleSoft, and SBU Reporting.
* Graduate Academics:

  + Track and advise current students on their progress through degree requirements in coordination with MFA Directors. Working with other administrative professionals, assist with class scheduling, running scheduling reports, monitoring course enrollment, processing permissions, and other processes within PeopleSoft. Advise students on registration issues, academic policies, leaves-of-absence, and change-of-status forms, including impacts on funding, in compliance with Graduate School policies and forms.
  + Advise program directors and faculty on student eligibility for TA appointments and additional compensation; troubleshoot GTA contract issues including parking passes, health insurance, and stipend questions. Collaborate directly with Program Directors, the Graduate School, and Human Resources to accurately identify, record, and track graduate assistant (GA) and teaching assistant (TA) appointments for both funded and unfunded students. In coordination with Human Resources, the incumbent is responsible for initiating and managing electronic documentation and appointments for eligible students using such systems as Docusign, WolfieOne, or other programs.
  + Serving as a key departmental liaison, this role consults regularly with Program Directors regarding student status, while taking ownership of ensuring that assignments, stipend amounts, Graduate Tuition Scholarships (GTS), and course underloads are reported to the Graduate School and other departments in a timely manner. Coordinate thesis committee formation, milestone documentation, and scheduling of thesis presentations and film screenings.
  + Coordinate degree clearances for CWL, FLM, and TVW graduates; maintain student records; resolve grade discrepancies and transcript issues in coordination with the Registrar. Monitor GAs, who work 4–20 hours per week in their first and second years, conduct regular check-ins and maintain ongoing communication with faculty responsible for GA assignments to ensure workloads are appropriate. Schedule GAs for the 6–9 PM bullpen shifts and any other off-hours coverage as needed.
* Faculty and Office Support:

  + Provide administrative support to department senior leadership and other assigned faculty and staff. Serve as the initial point of contact for the Manhattan Center community, answering queries in person

Additionally, our remote work policy includes having a dedicated, distraction-free workspace. Remote work is not a substitute for childcare, elder care, or other personal responsibilities during working hours. To view our branch locations, please visit: ioausa.com/locations*

**About the Role****:** Responsible for IOA Benefits Account Management activities under Producer direction. Responsibilities include client service and communication, team leadership, directing daily tasks and work activities of Account Coordinators, team and individual productivity, quality, and service levels, implementation of client benefits administrative processes, tracking, renewals, new client setup, data management/entry, Producer communication, team and individual professional development, identification of sales opportunities, and upholding IOA core values.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Client Management:** Manage an assigned book of business, ensuring performance requirements are met and no liability occurs.

* **Client Service:** Deliver outstanding service, anticipate client needs, maintain professional communication, and respond quickly to requests.

* **Team Leadership:** Lead the account team with a strong work ethic, positive attitude, and willingness to assist others.

* **Daily Activities:** Direct daily activities of Account Coordinator(s), assign tasks, communicate expectations, monitor execution, and recommend corrective actions.

* **Business Growth:** Identify and act on sales opportunities to grow IOA business.

* **New Business Setup:** Manage new business setup, including data gathering, client file creation, communication, AOR notifications, carrier rates, internal services setup, compliance audits, client education, and employee meetings.

* **Renewal Process:** Manage renewals by verifying client data, updating files, liaising with clients and carriers, obtaining rates, ensuring internal services usage, performing audits, coordinating training, and conducting meetings.

* **Client Relationships:** Build and improve client relationships, seek feedback, and implement improvements.

* **Intermediary Role:** Advocate for clients and carriers to ensure mutually beneficial outcomes.

* **Value-Added Solutions:** Identify and implement value-added solutions for clients.

* **Professional Development**: Support team training and development, promote a positive work environment, and seek continuous improvement.

* **Communication**: Maintain transparent communication with Producers and team members.

* **Compliance**: Ensure adherence to company policies and industry standards.

* Champion IOA core values and demonstrate integrity and leadership.

**Ideal Candidate****Qualifications:**

* 5+ years of industry experience

* Required active licensing

* Exceptional customer service and communication skills

* Strong organizational, delegation, and decision-making skills

* High accuracy in handling large work volumes

* Proficiency in MS Office (Outlook, Word, Excel)

* High School Diploma (or equivalent)

**What We Offer:**

* Competitive salaries and bonus potential

* Company-paid health insurance

* Paid holidays, vacations, and sick time

* 401K with employer match

* Professional growth and career progression opportunities

* Respectful culture and work/family life balance

* Community service commitment

* Supportive teammates and a rewarding work environment

**What****to Expect****(Application Process)****:**

* 30-Minute Phone Screen, Online Assessments, and Interview(s)

**Salary Range**

*The expected pay range for this position is 70-90K annually, depending on experience, relevant skills, and geographic location.*

Insurance Office of America is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

jobs.title: Events Sales Coordinator
jobs.description:
Reports to: Events Director  
Compensation: Base Salary plus commission

About Kent Hospitality Group:

Kent Hospitality Group is a visionary team reshaping hospitality through community, culture and excellence. Founded by the late Chef Jamal James Kent, this award-winning group delivers unrivaled experiences that are both welcoming and exceptional.
  
With a portfolio that includes Michelin-starred restaurants, private members clubs, and world-class venues, KHG creates destinations where guests and team members alike feel welcome and inspired. In partnership with entrepreneur-led private equity group SC Holdings, we believe extraordinary hospitality begins with extraordinary teams, valuing not just what we create, but how we work together to bring it to life.

Position Summary

The Events Coordinator must be capable of working directly with and taking direction from the events team to achieve the restaurant’s common goal of guest satisfaction. The Events Coordinator must work with a warm, knowledgeable & noticeably appreciative demeanor. The role of the Events Coordinator is integral to the success of the restaurant- you must show passion for providing extraordinary service and a desire to help out where needed.

Key Responsibilities

* Support events managers in various aspects of the event planning and execution process- such as opening and managing client general inquiry communications, BEO creation, facilitating menu approval & printing, requesting and coordinating outside vendor rentals and COIs (AV, florals, etc), planning and executing offsite events, contracting events in accordance to company terms, communicating with reservation/Chef/Dining/Kitchen teams.
* Update events calendar and communicate calendar to the Hospitality Team.
* Setting, communicating and maintaining timelines and priorities.
* Communicating, maintaining and developing client relationships.
* Providing leadership, motivation, direction, and support to your team.
* Ensuring excellent customer service and quality delivery.
* Have knowledge of ‘who’s who’ at KHG Restaurants.
* Know and be able to explain what Crown Shy and Saga means & their mission.

jobs.title: Sales Coordinator - 9 Orchard
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Nine Orchard is a 113-room hotel in the restored 1912 bank building at the corner of Canal and Orchard on Manhattan's Lower East Side. The property is design-forward and service-driven, with a notable food and beverage program that draws equally from hotel guests and neighborhood regulars. Nine Orchard operates with the intimacy of a small property and the rigor of a top-tier hotel.

Nine Orchard is looking for a Sales & Marketing Coordinator who brings genuine passion for hospitality, a feel for the New York market, and the instincts to translate the hotel's identity into relationships and revenue.

This role is an important point of connection between prospective clients, the sales team, hotel operations, and food and beverage partners — supporting group business, corporate accounts, private events, and related revenue-generating opportunities from initial inquiry through contracting and post-event follow-up. You will work closely with hotel leadership to drive group, corporate, and leisure business while supporting the broader marketing presence of the property, from social content and partnerships to press inquiries and brand collateral. Reports to the Director of Sales & Marketing.

WHAT YOU'LL OWN

Sales

* Manage inbound group, return guest, VIP and corporate inquiries from initial contact through contract, qualifying each opportunity
* Develop and maintain relationships with travel agents, corporate accounts, event planners, and local business contacts
* Enter group rooming lists with detail and accuracy
* Prepare proposals, presentations, contracts, and banquet event orders that reflect the hotel's voice and standards
* Follow up with inquiries in timely fashion

Sales operations & VIP coordination

* Prepare and distribute pre-arrival resumes for all VIP and group arrivals, ensuring Front Office, F&B, and Housekeeping are briefed and ready
* Collect, organize, and track artist and talent riders; coordinate fulfillment with relevant hotel departments ahead of arrival
* Manage amenity and room assignment coordination for VIP, celebrity, and high-touch guests in close partnership with Front Office and Housekeeping
* Maintain and update group and VIP arrival logs; track action items from the daily arrivals report and follow through on delivery
* Serve as the internal point of contact for group and VIP business from contract through departure; own the entire cycle from booking to post-stay
* Maintain account-level notes in the PMS and sales systems

Marketing

* Assist with email marketing campaigns, seasonal promotions, and partnerships
* Manage and update photography assets and brand collateral
* Coordinate with the F&B team on programming, events, and cross-promotional opportunities
* Support press and media inquiries in partnership with the hotel's PR contacts

Administration & operations

* Maintain the CRM and account database with accurate, up-to-date information
* Prepare weekly and monthly sales reports, comp set analyses, and market trend summaries
* Liaise with Front Office, F&B, and Events to ensure group and VIP arrivals are executed seamlessly
* Manage the sales calendar, including site inspections, client meetings, and trade show participation

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Required

* 2–4 years of experience in hospitality sales, marketing, or a related guest-facing role
* Background in a boutique, independent, or lifestyle hotel — you understand what makes properties like Nine Orchard different
* Strong written and verbal communication skills; you can write a compelling proposal and hold a room in a client meeting
* Comfortable working independently and across departments in a lean, fast-moving environment
* Organized, detail-oriented, and able to juggle multiple priorities without dropping the ball
* Flexible availability to support site visits, client events, and travel shows as needed

Preferred

* Existing relationships in the New York market: corporate accounts, travel trade, event planners, or media
* Familiarity with hotel sales systems (Delphi, Opera Sales & Catering, or similar)
* Experience with social media management tools and email marketing platforms
* Knowledge of the New York lifestyle, F&B, and events landscape
* Multilingual abilities

WHAT WE EXPECT IN THE FIRST 12 MONTHS

* Sales inquiries, proposals, and client communications are handled promptly, accurately, and on-brand
* Operational teams reliably receive clear, complete information ahead of every group, event, and VIP arrival
* You've built genuine relationships with clients and key accounts, and the team can rely on your reporting and follow-through to help convert business and grow revenue

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS

* Base pay: $ 65,000- $70,000 annually, commensurate with experience
* Health, dental, and vision insurance
* Unlimited Paid time off
* Paid parental leave
* Life and disability insurance
* Employee dining discounts
* Career-development and advancement opportunities

ABOUT MML HOSPITALITY

MML Hospitality operates a portfolio of culturally relevant hotels and restaurants including Hotel Saint Vincent (New Orleans) and Nine Orchard (New York), along with the food and beverage operations at The Driskill and The Proper in Austin — with two new properties and membership clubs opening in 2027. We are an equal opportunity employer and consider all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

**Administrative Coordinator, Bureau of Food Safety and Community Sanitation**
==============================================================================

Salary range: $61,656.00 – $70,904.00

Save

**Job Description**
-------------------

Open to candidates who are permanent.
  
  
The New York City Department of Health and Mental Hygiene’s Division of Environmental Health works to prevent and control illness and injury related to environmental and occupational health risks through outreach, education, surveillance, and enforcement. With staff of 1,000, the Division covers a broad range of subject matter, including oversight of environmental investigations, lead poisoning, prevention, occupational health, food safety, childcare, radiation control, recreational and drinking water quality, air quality, climate health, vector control, veterinary public health, and pest control. The Bureau of Food Safety and Community Sanitation (BFSCS) protects the public, including New York's most vulnerable citizens from a broad range of hazards that may pose a threat to health or safety. DOHMH is mandated to inspect 26,000 restaurants annually, school cafeterias, and mobile food vending unit, adult day care centers, senior centers, soup kitchens, homeless shelters, and other facilities.
  
  
DUTIES WILL INCLUDE BUT NOT BE LIMITED TO:
  

* Serve as a point of contact for all front-end MFV customer service interactions, maintaining high-quality care and effectively routing inquiries.
* Prepare and maintain various data and facility reports, logs, and tracking analyses to support informed decision-making by the Regional Director.
* Provide customer care services through phone and in-person interactions regarding mobile food vending permits and licenses, including guiding customers on required documentation.
* Assist in logistical planning and execution of operations, including scheduling appointments for Mobile Food Vendors pre-permit inspections, and inventory control.
* Organize and host training sessions, ensuring designated facility space is available for administrative and custodial staff.
* Address inquiries from the Bureau’s Health & Safety Coordinator and maintain compliance with health and safety regulations.
* Collaborate with Human Resources regarding personnel matters such as training and documentation.
* Work with the Director of Communications to ensure the facility has up-to-date literature and messaging for customer service needs.
* Support the Bureau’s Project Support Specialist with updates on vehicle usage and documentation.
* Coordinate with the Sr. Procurement Coordinator to monitor supplies and report any IT or resource issues.
* Assist with additional administrative duties and special projects as assigned to support the program.

  
PREFERRED SKILLS:
  

* Excellent communication skills.
* Excellent interpersonal skills.
* Excellent decision making and problem-solving skills.
* Proficient with Microsoft Office
* Bilingual

  
Why you should work for us:
  
  

* Loan Forgiveness: As a prospective employee of the City of New York, you may be eligible for federal/state loan forgiveness and repayment assistance programs that lessen your payments or even fully forgive your full balance. For more information, please visit the U.S. Department of Education’s website (https://studentaid.gov/pslf/)
* Benefits: City employees are entitled to unmatched benefits such as:

o a premium-free health insurance plan that saves employees over $10K annually, per a 2024 assessment.
  
o additional health, fitness, and financial benefits may be available based on the position’s associated union/benefit fund.
  
o a public sector defined benefit pension plan with steady monthly payments in retirement.
  
o a tax-deferred savings program and
  
o a robust Worksite Wellness Program that offers resources and opportunities to keep you healthy while serving New Yorkers.
  

* Work From Home Policy: Depending on your position, you may be able to work up to two days during the week from home.

- Job Security - you could enjoy more job security compared to private sector employment and be able to contribute to making NYC a healthy place to live and work.
  
  
Established in 1805, the New York City Department of Health and Mental Hygiene (NYC Health Department) is the oldest and largest health department in the U.S., dedicated to protecting and improving the health of NYC. Our mission is to safeguard the health of every resident and cultivate a city where everyone, regardless of age, background, or location, can achieve their optimal health. We provide a wide array of programs and services focused on food and nutrition, anti-tobacco support, chronic disease prevention, HIV/AIDS treatment, family and child health, environmental health, mental health, and social justice initiatives. As the primary population health strategist and policy authority for NYC, with a rich history of public health initiatives and scientific advancements, from addressing the 1822 yellow fever outbreak to the COVID-19 pandemic, we serve as a global leader in public health innovation and expertise.
  
  
Come join us and help to continue our efforts in making a difference in the lives of all New Yorkers!

jobs.description:
Overview:

NRDC (the Natural Resources Defense Council) works to safeguard the Earth, its people, its plants and animals, and the natural systems on which all life depends. NRDC combines the power of more than 3 million members and online activists with the expertise of some 800 policy advocates, lawyers, scientists, and communication experts to confront the climate crisis, protect nature, ensure the rights of all people to clean air, clean water, and healthy communities. As an international nonprofit environmental organization, NRDC is working to address the world’s most urgent environmental challenges, and advance innovative, science-based, and enforceable solutions.

Since our founding in 1970, NRDC has helped craft and deliver many of America’s foundational environmental laws, including the Clean Air Act, Clean Water Act and Safe Drinking Water Act. Today, we continue to lead in advancing and defending strong environmental protections at the local, state, federal and international levels, as well as through the marketplace. Our team works across the United States and around the world, from offices in Chicago, Los Angeles, New York City, San Francisco, and Washington, D.C., as well as in Beijing, and New Delhi (a subsidiary of NRDC India Pvt. Ltd.).

Supported by our members and online activists, NRDC is driving impactful solutions that confront the climate crisis, defend nature and safeguard public health across Asia, Africa, and the Americas. At NRDC, we believe lasting change happens when people bring their talent, passion, and expertise together for a common purpose: to build a cleaner, healthier, and more resilient world. Learn more at nrdc.org

**POSITION SUMMARY**

The Administrative Coordinator will provide administrative and operations support for the Green Finance & Economic Development department whose mission is to: accelerate the shift to a sustainable, resilient, and equitable financial and economic system, and mobilize public resources and private capital for climate investment that reduces emissions and enhances livelihoods and lives.

This position would be hybrid remote in either the New York office (preferred) or DC

The position you are applying for is part of the bargaining unit represented by The Washington Baltimore News Guild (WBNG / The Newsguild-CWA Local 32035).

Responsibilities:

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the following essential functions:

* Provide administrative and logistical support to assigned teams, per NRDC’s administrative guidelines. This includes, but is not limited to:
  + Provide budgeting and accounting support, including processing invoices, maintaining contracts, preparing reports, and tracking spend.
  + Responsible for contract submission and facilitation of institutional processes related to contract approval and vendor set-up.
  + Manage electronic filing systems and databases related to contracts, invoices and other team files for the assigned team.
* Provide administrative and logistical support to assigned team members, per NRDC’s administrative guidelines. This may include, but is not limited to:
  + Schedule calendar appointments and meetings.
  + Draft, edit, format, or proofread materials, correspondence or reports.
  + Create and submit expense reports on behalf of assigned team members and book travel and plan associated logistics.
  + Schedule, organize, prepare for, and follow-up on assigned meetings, including planning logistics, preparing materials, taking notes, and sending out action items.
  + Assist with event planning and production, which may require working with external parties, event scheduling, arranging catering, printing, materials preparation, and liaising with different stakeholders as needed.
* Provide support to ensure effective communication, collaboration, and information-sharing within the department and with external institutional partners.
* Support execution of special projects identified by the Operations Manager.

The above list of duties is not comprehensive but generally demonstrates the types of matters under this position’s responsibility. Other duties may be assigned.

Qualifications:

**Minimum Education & Experience:**

* High School Diploma or GED.
* 1-3 years of relevant work experience.
* And/or equivalent education or experience.

**Skills, Abilities, Competencies**

* Commitment to NRDC’s mission, values, and DEI principles
* Ability to travel to NRDC U.S. based offices, approximately 5% annually
* Demonstrated ability to perform or quickly learn new tasks, systems, and technology.
* Ability to prioritize and efficiently execute multiple tasks, follow institutional procedures, and work independently with strong attention to detail.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong problem-solving skills.
* Excellent editing, research, and data synthesis skills.
* Willingness and flexibility to work paid overtime, when needed.
* Orientation towards working with a broad range of people on different projects.
* Strict adherence to confidentiality requirements and discretion with sensitive information
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook), in addition to ability to learn accounting and finance systems, as well as relevant NRDC specific software and platforms.
* Proficiency with Asana or similar project management platforms preferred.

jobs.description:
Marketing & Communications
  
  
Global Experiential Marketing Manager, GIMC GBM - GBS
  
  
**Location :**  
New York
  
  
**Employment Type :**  
Regular
  
  
**Job Code :**  
A207846
  
  
Responsibilities
  
  
The Global Business Marketing (GBM) team champions TikTok in the B2B landscape, showing advertisers and sales teams how TikTok's creative ecosystem drives real business results. We build the stories, education, and go-to-market programs that sellers use to deepen client relationships across markets. Working with brands of all sizes, we also bring campaigns to life through creative ideation, brand and event strategy, and the design and production of TikTok for Business marketing, so advertisers can create content that connect with audiences. Trends, consumer behavior, and advertising formats all move quickly on TikTok. The challenge is turning what makes the platform engaging into solutions that are creative, measurable, and scalable across very different markets, without making the experience feel like traditional advertising. You will shape how the market understands TikTok as a business platform, and help brands show up authentically on it. The vision of the Global Integrated Marketing Communications (GIMC) Team within Global Business Marketing (GBM) is to create a global brand that amplifies our mission and establishes TikTok as a unique and critical investment for the industry we serve. Fostering best in class creative work on our platform, inspiring the industry through storytelling and showcasing our unique business brand at scale is the core focus of our collective team. Our purpose is to inspire, educate and unlock the possibilities on TikTok for the marketing community and businesses of all sizes. The Experiential Marketing Manager owns end-to-end program leadership for TikTok’s most complex global B2B tentpole moments, currently anchored by Cannes Lions. This role owns the full program from building awareness and demand ahead of the event, through strategy, creative development and execution, to post-event follow-up and measuring results. This person is the overall program owner, bringing together strategy, creative, events, marketing, sales and other partners to ensure every part of the program works together and delivers against its goals. While the role has deep ownership of the event experience and production, the responsibility extends beyond the event itself to the full audience journey and what happens before and after the moment. In addition, this role oversees the production engine for the broader global events portfolio, helping establish the processes, partners and standards that allow the team to deliver high-quality work efficiently and consistently. Responsibilities Own the Program End to End - Own the full program for assigned global tentpoles, from planning and building demand ahead of the event through execution, post-event follow-up and measuring results - Develop the overall plan for the program, aligning teams around goals, audiences, key moments and priorities - Serve as the central point of coordination across Channels, Creative, Marketing, Product, Sales, Comms, Legal, Executive teams, etc - Ensure the experience, content, communications and follow-up all work together as one cohesive program - Identify risks, challenges and resource needs early and bring forward clear solutions Lead the Event and Experience - Lead planning and execution across the full event footprint, including creative development, programming, production, logistics, talent and attendee experience - Partner closely with Creative to develop a cohesive and distinctive TikTok brand experience - Manage relationships with executives, talent and high-profile guests, including complex logistics and negotiations - Own budgets, timelines, agencies, vendors and production partners to ensure the program is delivered on time, on budget and to a high standard Oversee the Production Engine - Oversee production and delivery across the broader global events portfolio, including vendor and agency management, budgets and coordination across workstreams - Build and improve processes, tools and templates that make it easier for the team to deliver great work consistently - Build and maintain strong relationships with agencies, vendors and venue partners - Partner with the Director of Global Events & Experiential Strategy and other Program Leads to align on standards, ways of working and success measures across the portfolio Lead and Develop the Team - Mentor and develop team members, helping them grow their event and program leadership skills - Help the team work more effectively across functions and build stronger ways of working - Identify opportunities to improve how the organization plans, delivers and measures events
  
  
Qualifications
  
  
Minimum Qualifications - Leadership experience in relevant events/program management experience, including ownership of large-scale, multi-stakeholder global programs - Demonstrated ability to manage complex, high-stakes programs end-to-end including budget, vendor/agency management, executive relationships, on-site execution - Strong operational and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple concurrent workstreams under tight deadlines - Strong judgment and composure, with a track record of navigating organizational change without losing team stability - A growing strategic voice with experience or demonstrated potential to help shape upstream program strategy, not only execute an established plan - Excellent cross-functional communication and stakeholder management skills Preferred Qualifications - Experience working in advertising or B2B marketing - Demonstrated experience with new client acquisition or demand generation events, including working with Sales on audience, conversion goals, and pipeline tracking

#### **NICE TO MEET YOU!**

We’re excited to get to know you - if this role sounds like a fit.  
  
Our ideal candidate combines warm hospitality with commercial drive and a genuine passion for food. You own a book of corporate clients across New York, from the first launch day through every renewal, and make sure each office loves its FELFEL fridge. You are the trusted partner for HR and workplace leads, the voice of the client inside FELFEL, and the one who turns happy accounts into growing ones.  
  
You're a natural relationship builder who takes real ownership of your accounts. You're highly organized and proactive, and when something doesn't go to plan, you're already working on the solution. You're as comfortable managing a client's expectations as you are handling the operational details behind every delivery, and you keep Sales, Operations and Food aligned through clear, timely communication. You bring a hospitality or food service background, hold yourself accountable, and believe there's always a way to make the experience even better.  
  
Who are we? FELFEL is one of New York’s hottest food-tech scale-ups, changing the way people eat at work. Our smart fridges bring the city’s best local chefs and trendiest restaurants straight to the office. Our founders are closely involved here in New York as we build out this new region alongside our Swiss market, where we already serve more than 1,000 clients.

#### **YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Own the relationship with your book of corporate clients as the primary point of contact for HR leads, office managers and workplace experience leads. Build trust and a strategic understanding of each account to create tailored solutions, and represent FELFEL's brand and values with clients, partners and teammates
* Lead onboarding for new clients and new office launches: plan, coordinate, and execute the setup and go-live in partnership with clients and internal teams
* Own the renewal cycle for your book. Guide clients through their trial phase and first year to secure strong retention, align our services with each client's goals and budget, and drive upsell and cross-sell opportunities
* Ensure delivery excellence and exceptional hospitality at every touchpoint. Work closely with your Customer Success Associates to deliver a great onsite experience, and resolve issues and escalations with urgency
* Partner cross-functionally with Sales, Operations, Food, Marketing, and Finance to support business development, ensure seamless implementation, and champion service/product improvements
* Lead quarterly reviews and product samplings to gather feedback, show account performance and introduce new offerings.
* Keep client records, contracts and renewal dates accurate in our CRM. Track account KPIs, prepare client and internal reports, and help build and standardize processes as we grow

#### **YOUR PROFILE**

* You have 5+ years of experience in account management, client success, or B2B hospitality, ideally in food, workplace services, or a fast-growing start-up

* You're comfortable with a CRM (HubSpot a plus) and Google Workspace or Microsoft Office. A bachelor's degree or equivalent experience is preferred, and you're authorized to work in the United States (no visa sponsorship provided)
* You have a passion for good food and believe office workers deserve a better lunch, every day.

* **Retention** - Keep your clients happy and engaged, and secure their renewals. Make sure their FELFEL setup delivers value that clearly exceeds what they pay.
* **Account growth** - Grow each account with additional subsidies, new products and expansion into the client's other offices.
* **Adoption** - Drive strong, steady fridge usage at every client office, working with your Customer Success Associates to turn employees into regulars
* **Client Satisfaction** - Make every client's experience best in class, reflected in your accounts' Net Promoter Score.

* Exceptional Italian coffee and a selection of fine teas
* Central Flatiron office and Brooklyn location, surrounded by NYC’s best culinary inspiration
* 20 days of PTO + 10 holidays (some flexible)
* Comprehensive healthcare options
* 401k options
* Paid parental leave

  

* Benefits may evolve over time — this reflects what we currently offer.

**Ready to apply? If this sounds like the perfect role, we can't wait to hear from you!**

FELFEL is a modern corporate catering solution: chef-made, ultra-fresh meals available 24/7 — like an office restaurant, but at a fraction of the cost of traditional office catering. jobs.title: Business Development Representative – Home Care (Bilingual English/Spanish)
jobs.description:
### **Company Description**

Special Touch Home Care is seeking a bilingual business development professional with an outgoing personality, a talent for building relationships, and a passion for connecting people with the care they need.

For 40 years, our licensed home care services agency (LHCSA) has proudly served more than 100,000 clients throughout New York City's five boroughs and Westchester County. Our success is built on compassionate care, dependable service, and the dedicated people who make it possible.

If you enjoy meeting new people, getting involved in the community, and seeing your efforts make a difference, we'd love to have you on our team.

### **Job Description**

As our Business Development Representative, you will help expand our reach by promoting our services to potential clients, healthcare professionals, and community organizations.

This role is primarily office-based, with outreach and attendance at local events and meetings on occasion. You will ensure office visitors receive welcoming, professional customer service while building relationships with businesses and referral sources to generate new client opportunities. You will represent Special Touch Home Care in the community and work closely with our intake team to connect prospective clients with our services.

### **Responsibilities**

* Manage the local office and ensure all visitors receive attentive, professional service.
* Develop and implement marketing and outreach strategies to generate leads and increase client referrals.
* Build and maintain relationships with healthcare professionals, hospitals, rehabilitation centers, assisted living facilities, local businesses, and other referral sources.
* Participate in networking events, health fairs, and community presentations to raise awareness of our services.
* Conduct outreach to potential clients and follow up on new opportunities.
* Collaborate with our community intake team to facilitate the intake process for new clients.
* Educate healthcare professionals and community members about our services and how to make referrals.
* Track outreach activity, leads, and referrals to evaluate results and improve strategies.
* Stay informed about industry trends, competitor activities, and community needs to identify opportunities for growth.

### **Qualifications**

* Associate's degree or higher required.
* Fluency in English and Spanish required.
* Minimum of 2 years of business development experience required, with a demonstrated track record of generating leads, building relationships, and driving business growth.
* Healthcare business dev experience preferred, but not required.
* An outgoing personality and strong interpersonal skills, with the ability to build relationships with people from diverse backgrounds.
* Excellent verbal communication, writing, and presentation skills.
* A self-motivated, results-oriented approach and a passion for making a positive impact.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong organizational and follow-up skills.
* Proficiency in Google Workspace is a plus.

### **Schedule**

Full-time, Monday–Friday, 9 AM–5 PM, with occasional hours outside this schedule based on department needs.

### **Compensation**

$50,000–$85,000 annually, based on experience and its relevance to the role and our company's needs, plus commissions.

**YES, there's room for growth!**

### **Benefits**

* Competitive salary plus commissions.
* Comprehensive benefits package, including health insurance and paid time off.
* Opportunities for growth—we frequently promote from within the company.

jobs.description:
Hudson Creative is seeking a Digital Marketing Intern to join our team as part of a 4-month training program designed to teach, mentor, and prepare outstanding interns for a full-time role and career path. This internship is intended for recent college graduates (or soon-to-be graduates) with less than 1 year of relevant digital marketing experience who are excited for practical training and development by our amazing team. This role is a great opportunity for both analytically-minded and creatively-driven candidates who are interested in how paid ads, SEO, social media, email marketing, and visual storytelling intersect in the restaurant and hospitality industries.

**Quick Facts:**

* Internship Period: 4 months starting October 2026 (flexible start and end dates)
* Location: NYC
* Work policy: Hybrid with 3 days per week onsite at our midtown office (Grand Central)
* Hours: Full-Time (9:00am - 5:30pm EST)
* Compensation: $2,200/month stipend
* Mentorship: Daily progress check-ins with your manager to ensure growth and successful completion of the internship
* Reports to: Digital Marketing Director

**What You’ll Do & Learn** You’ll support real client work and get hands-on exposure across key areas of digital marketing:

**Paid Media**

* Learn how to set up and support paid campaigns (Google Ads, Meta, TikTok, etc.)
* Assist with campaign monitoring, pacing, and performance reporting
* Gain exposure to optimization strategies and data-driven decision making

**SEO & Website Support**

* Assist with keyword research and on-page optimizations
* Support local listing updates across Google, Yelp, Apple, and other platforms
* Assist with citation management and submissions through BrightLocal
* Support website updates across platforms like WordPress, Shopify, Squarespace, and BentoBox
* Help QA website updates to ensure accuracy, functionality, and proper tracking

**Reporting & Analytics**

* Assist with recurring performance reporting and dashboard updates
* Help analyze campaign and website performance to identify trends and insights
* Gain exposure to GA4, Google Tag Manager, Looker Studio, and Google Sheets
* Support tracking QA and validation to ensure accurate reporting

**Client Experience & Strategy**

* Join internal and external meetings to observe strategy development
* Participate in discussions on trends, optimizations, and campaign planning
* Contribute ideas in a collaborative, supportive environment

**Who You Are:**

* Rising seniors or new graduates who recently finished their degree in advertising, marketing, business administration, communications or related field
* Passion for advertising and the hospitality industry
* Interest in performance marketing, analytics, SEO, or digital advertising
* Excellent time management and organizational skills
* Strong attention to detail, especially when handling data or website updates
* A team player who thrives in a fast-paced environment and is ready to contribute and learn
* Familiarity with tools like Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, Google Analytics, or SEO platforms is a plus
* Comfort working with data in Excel/Google Sheets
* Prior experience or interest in the restaurant and hospitality industry is a plus

**Why This Internship?**

* A structured, supportive learning environment
* Exposure to multiple digital channels to find your strengths and interests
* Real work for hospitality brands and hands-on training with our senior team
* A clear development path with potential for full-time placement

**Perks:**

* Company issued Apple laptop for your day-to-day productivity
* Flexible hybrid work policy with convenient office location near Grand Central Station
* Team events including happy hours and quarterly wellness activities
* Cold brew, coffee, tea and kombucha on tap, as well as office snacks for the midday pick-me-up
* Exposure to a wide network of hospitality and industry partners
* Growth-oriented culture with room to take on responsibility quickly

**Interview Process:** Jumpstart your career at www.hudsoncreative.com/careers. Please include both a resume and cover letter for consideration.

* Round 2: Live practical marketing exercise to apply your understanding and skillset
* Round 3: Video interview with a member of our marketing team to share your analysis and strategic approach.
* Round 4: On-site interview with our account director.

Our experienced team has a strong passion for driving meaningful results that make game-changing business impacts for clients.

jobs.title: Business Development Representative
jobs.description:
**About Emerald**

Emerald’s talented and experienced teams grow our customers’ businesses 365 days a year with products that create connections, deliver content, and drive commerce. We produce over 140 annual events, create and deliver content through print and digital channels, and power commerce through our seamlessly integrated in-person and digital platforms and channels. For more information, please visit http://www.emeraldx.com.

Forge is looking for a high-energy Business Development pro to help grow revenue across our portfolio of trade shows and conferences. You’ll be the person who finds the right companies to talk to, starts the conversation, and qualifies opportunities for our Account Executives to close.

If you like digging into research, testing what messaging works, and using tools like Gong and Salesforce to build a pipeline, you’ll fit right in. You’ll help create pipeline through modern outbound prospecting — combining research, signal-based targeting, and consultative outreach. This is a fast-paced, “learn by doing” role with clear coaching, measurable goals, and a strong path into an Account Executive career track.

**Location: Alpharetta, GA or New York, NY (Broadway) — hybrid options may be available based on team needs.**

Why this role matters: You’ll create the top of the funnel—turning target accounts into real conversations and qualified meetings that become event and sponsorship revenue.

**Responsibilities**

* Research net-new exhibitor and sponsor accounts using ZoomInfo industry intelligence, and signal-based prospecting (intent, trigger events, engagement signals.
* Build targeted lists and run multi-threaded outreach cadences (email, phone, social) while keeping clean notes and next steps in Salesforce.
* Qualify prospects through short discovery conversations—confirming fit, goals, decision process, and timing—so we focus on high-potential opportunities.
* Create personalized outreach that connects a prospect’s business goals to the value of Forge’s events (ROI, audience, leads, brand visibility).
* Partner closely with Account Executives for a smooth handoff—sharing research, key contacts, conversation notes, and recommended next steps.
* Collaborate with Marketing and attendee teams to share feedback on lead quality, personas, and campaigns—then adjust targeting and messaging accordingly.
* Stay current on industry trends, competitor events, and emerging categories; bring new ideas for who we should be selling to next.
* Occasionally support the close by stepping in to run pricing/package conversations when needed.

**What we’re looking for**

* 0–2 years of experience in sales, customer success, recruiting, fundraising, hospitality, or another role where you had to build relationships and hit goals (internships count).
* Comfortable with outbound outreach (calls + email) and willing to practice, iterate, and get better fast.
* Tech savvy: experience using Salesforce (or another CRM) and confidence learning new tools quickly.
* Organized and self-directed—you can manage a daily outreach plan, follow-ups, and deadlines without things slipping.
* Strong communication skills: you can write clear, professional messages and speak confidently with new people.
* Be a consultative partner! Understand basic discovery methods (BANT) business pain, priorities, stakeholders, and decision process.
* Ability to travel up to 30% (some events require on-site time).

**Success Metrics**

* You will be measured on pipeline created, qualified opportunities, conversion, target account penetration, activity effectiveness.

**Nice to have**

* Experience with Gong, ZoomInfo, sales engagement tools, or list-building tools.
* Comfort with light data analysis (Excel/Google Sheets) to track activity and results.
* Interest in events, media, marketing, or B2B communities—and curiosity about how businesses grow.

**What success looks like (first 90 days)**

*First 30 Days*

* Learn markets, messaging, systems, and outreach standards.

*60 Days*

* Consistently execute outbound cadence and generate qualified meetings.

*90 Days*

* Create repeatable pipeline contribution and begin influencing targeting and messaging.

**About Emerald**

At Emerald, we strive to foster a diverse and inclusive community. **NEW YORK/NEW JERSEY**

**POSITION OVERVIEW**

NextMDLink, its affiliates, and NanoPass Technologies are seeking a motivated, results-driven Territory Medical Sales Representative & MicronJet™ Product Specialist to launch and grow MicronJet, NanoPass’s FDA-cleared intradermal delivery platform, throughout New York and New Jersey.

This is a field-based medical sales position focused on new-account acquisition, market penetration and recurring revenue. The representative will prospect for new business, develop relationships with cosmetic dermatology, plastic surgery and medical-aesthetic practices, conduct product demonstrations and manage accounts from the initial sale through continued utilization and reorders.

The representative will enter the territory with a fairly new established foundation, supporting the MicronJet rollout across more than 90 locations within one of the country’s largest dermatology organizations. The representative will also develop additional accounts and cross-sell products from the broader NextMD regenerative and aesthetic portfolio.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Prospect for and open new cosmetic dermatology, plastic surgery and medical-aesthetic accounts throughout New York and New Jersey.
* Build and manage a qualified sales pipeline through field visits, telephone outreach, referrals, networking and industry events.
* Develop relationships with physicians, practice owners, medical directors and purchasing decision-makers.
* Conduct sales presentations, product evaluations and in-person demonstrations.
* Manage the sales process from initial outreach through closing, onboarding and account growth.
* Support the MicronJet rollout across more than 90 established dermatology locations.
* Provide product onboarding and practitioner training after completing company-provided education.
* Monitor utilization and reorder activity to support retention and recurring revenue.
* Expand established accounts by developing additional providers and identifying cross-selling opportunities.
* Represent the broader NextMD portfolio of regenerative, aesthetic and delivery products.
* Create and execute an organized territory sales plan.
* Maintain accurate CRM records, pipeline information and sales forecasts.
* Represent MicronJet, NextMDLink, its affiliates, and NanoPass at meetings, conferences and industry events.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* Demonstrated sales, prospecting, relationship-building or business-development ability.
* Strong communication, presentation, organization and follow-up skills.
* Confidence interacting with physicians, practice owners and clinical teams.
* Ability to learn and accurately communicate technical product information.
* Self-motivated, coachable and comfortable working independently.
* Valid driver’s license, reliable transportation and willingness to travel frequently throughout the territory.
* Residence within New York or New Jersey.

**PREFERRED EXPERIENCE**

* One to three years of outside sales, B2B sales, business development or account-management experience.
* Experience in medical aesthetics, medical devices, dermatology, plastic surgery, skincare or regenerative medicine.

* Experience selling consumable products and developing recurring reorder business.
* Experience with product demonstrations, practitioner training or new-product launches.
* Experience working with multi-location practices or physician groups.
* Proficiency with CRM and common business-productivity platforms.
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant experience.
* Residence in Northern New Jersey or the greater New York metropolitan area.

**IDEAL CANDIDATE**

The ideal candidate is confident, polished and sales-driven. You enjoy opening doors, building relationships and developing a territory. You are comfortable prospecting, asking for the sale and following through after an account is opened.

You can learn technical information and present it credibly to medical professionals, while remaining focused on the primary objectives of the position: new business, revenue growth, customer retention and recurring sales.

jobs.description:
CareDx is a leading precision medicine diagnostics company advancing care in transplant, specialty oncology, and cell therapy. Through our innovative portfolio of molecular diagnostics, digital health solutions, AI-powered data and analytics, and patient support services, we partner with healthcare providers, patients, and biopharma organizations to help inform clinical decision-making and improve patient outcomes.

At CareDx, every employee has the opportunity to contribute to innovations that help transform patient care and improve lives.

  

The Cell Therapy Account Manager is responsible for driving adoption and volume growth of the CareDx Cell Therapy & Transplant portfolio, including AlloHeme and associated molecular testing and digital solutions. Focusing primarily on blood and marrow transplant centers, cell therapy programs, hematology-oncology practices, and academic medical centers, the Cell Therapy Account Manager will educate providers on the clinical value of AlloHeme, support implementation of new testing programs, and drive ongoing utilization through strategic account management.

The Cell Therapy Account Manager will coordinate and collaborate with Clinical Liaisons, Medical Affairs, Customer Experience, Marketing, and Sales Operations to develop and execute account-specific growth strategies. jobs.description:

The Foster Home Licensing Coordinator for La Jornada is responsible for licensing foster homes for short-term transitional foster care. The Foster Home Licensing Coordinator is responsible for licensing, re-licensing, and retention of quality foster homes and ensuring licensed homes meet or exceed bed capacity in the assigned location. Bachelor’s Degree required Bilingual English/Spanish preferred.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

The Foster Home Licensing Coordinator for La Jornada will perform duties including, but not limited to:

* Actively support, represent, and extend the mission, vision, and values of the organization.
* Responsible for conducting home studies, assisting foster parents in completing licensing applications, initiating background check process, and delivering all required foster parent training in a timely manner.
* Work closely with the Foster Parent Recruiter in a collaborative capacity to accommodate foster parents’ licensing and documentary needs, identify and overcome licensing barriers.
* Develop a comprehensive home study for each potential family and submit for approval.
* Schedule all required foster home inspections per state licensing inspections and assist foster parents in prepping homes for the inspections.
* Follow the recruitment and retention plan to assist foster families in meeting and maintaining initial and ongoing trainings, certifications, and licensure requirements.
* Maintain constant foster parent communication to keep foster caregivers updated on the licensing process and resolve licensing issues.
* Maintain ongoing contact with State licensing agencies, state and Federal stakeholders as needed.
* Act as Program Subject Matter Expert (SME) in matters related to licensing/ recruiting, bed capacity. Responsible for updating the cross functional team, including the Intake Team, of bed availability and completing reports/logs.
* Upload, maintain and update all foster parent information and home records in Evolve Program: keeping, maintaining, organizing physical files for audits.
* Participate as representative of the Program in state file audits as required.
* Other duties are requested.
* Perform all work in a manner consistent with the National Youth Advocate Program’s mission, values, and philosophies.

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor’s degree in social work or comparable Human Services field from an accredited institution.
* Two (2) years of work experience working in direct service with minors and families strongly preferred.
* Proficient use of desktop and laptop computers, smartphones and tablets, printers, fax machines, and photocopiers, as well as software including word processing, spreadsheet, and database programs.
* Bilingual (English/Spanish). Fluency in Spanish is required.
* Minimum automobile insurance coverage of $100,000/300,000 bodily liability coverage.
* 21 years of age, valid state driver’s license, reliable personal vehicle and a good driving record.

**OTHER SKILLS**

* A willingness to work flexible and non-traditional hours in the service of foster caregivers, families of origin, and persons served.
* Capacity to be flexible and responsive to minors served, foster caregivers, system partners, and internal customers.

**PHYSICAL DEMANDS**

* Use of manual dexterity, tactile, visual, and audio acuity.
* Use of repetitive motion, prolonged periods of sitting and standing, and sustained visual and mental applications and demands.
* Occasional lifting (up to 25 pounds), bending, pulling, and carrying.
* Ability to travel frequently and drive vehicle while sitting for extended periods, with frequency varying based on program demands.

jobs.title: Marketing Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About America’s Best House Plans**

America’s Best House Plans is an established ecommerce company offering one of the country’s leading collections of residential house plans from more than 100 independent designers. We help homeowners and building professionals find the right home design through an extensive plan collection, expert customer service, and an easy-to-use digital shopping experience.

We’re looking for a creative, organized, and proactive Marketing Coordinator to help execute our marketing initiatives and strengthen how we connect with customers.

  

**About the Role**

The Marketing Coordinator is a hands-on position supporting marketing across social media, email, SMS, website content, promotions, and customer engagement.

Working closely with the Director of Marketing, you’ll help create content, execute campaigns, coordinate projects, engage with customers, and ensure marketing initiatives are completed accurately and on time.

  

**What You’ll Do**

* Create, schedule, and manage organic social media content and engage with our online community.
* Help create and coordinate content including social posts, blogs, videos, customer stories, home tours, and other marketing materials.
* Build and execute email and SMS campaigns, coordinating copy, creative, scheduling, segmentation, testing, and quality assurance.
* Support company promotions, website content, and integrated marketing campaigns across email, social, SMS, and other customer-facing channels.
* Help collect and organize customer photography, videos, testimonials, and other user-generated content.
* Coordinate marketing projects, calendars, deadlines, approvals, and deliverables, and help support marketing interns when needed.
* Collaborate with internal teams, customers, designers, builders, and outside partners on marketing content, assets, meetings, and initiatives.
* Track campaign and channel performance and help identify opportunities for improvement.
* Stay current on marketing, social media, ecommerce, home design, and consumer trends.
* Bring new ideas and creative thinking to how we market our products and engage with customers.
  

**What We're Looking For**

* 2–4 years of relevant marketing experience.
* Strong writing, proofreading, and communication skills.
* Excellent organization and attention to detail.
* Experience across multiple areas of digital marketing, such as social media, content creation, email marketing, and campaign execution.
* Experience creating graphics and short-form video content for digital and social channels.
* Comfortable managing multiple projects and deadlines at once.
* Proactive, dependable, and willing to take ownership of responsibilities.
* Comfortable reviewing marketing performance and using insights to improve future work.
* Ecommerce or consumer marketing experience is a plus.
  

**Benefits**

* Health, dental, and vision insurance
* Paid time off and company holidays
* Paid parental leave
* Simple IRA with employer match
* Annual bonus opportunity based on company performance
  

**Why Join Us?**

This role is ideal for someone who wants to work across multiple areas of marketing rather than being limited to one channel. You’ll contribute ideas, take ownership of initiatives, collaborate across the company, and see the impact your work has on our customers and the business.

We’re looking for someone creative, curious, organized, and excited to keep growing as a marketer while helping America’s Best House Plans reach and better serve customers planning one of the biggest projects of their lives — their home.

jobs.title: Traffic Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
**TRAFFIC CONTROL COORDINATOR**

**Position Summary**

The Traffic Control Coordinator supports daily traffic control operations by coordinating scheduling, personnel records, fleet, inventory, training, equipment, jobsite documentation, and administrative functions. This position works closely with management, field personnel, clients, vendors, and internal teams to ensure jobs are properly staffed, equipped, documented, and billed.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Scheduling & Administration:** Create and maintain schedules, fill open shifts, process call-offs and schedule changes, verify employee qualifications, review timecards, support payroll, monitor overtime, and maintain personnel records in Belfry.
* **Compliance & Training:** Track licenses, permits, certifications, and training expirations. Manage ATTSA Flagger Certification records, registrations, credential verification, and certification documentation.
* **Fleet Management:** Utilize Motive to monitor vehicles, mileage, GPS, fuel, driver activity, inspections, maintenance, and compliance. Maintain vehicle records and coordinate repairs, inspections, and required testing.
* **Inventory & Equipment:** Utilize Sortly to track equipment, tools, vehicles, and jobsite assets. Maintain accurate quantities, locations, assignments, transfers, returns, and damage records. Support procurement and equipment replenishment.
* **Jobsite/TCP Coordination:** Review TCPs and job requirements, verify equipment availability, coordinate shortages, create jobsite folders, schedule personnel, update Belfry and Outlook, and maintain required project documentation.
* **Job Closeout:** Verify equipment returns, document damaged or missing equipment, confirm employee hours for billing, and ensure checklists, quotes, Sortly reports, and supporting documents are uploaded and complete.
* **Communication & Reporting:** Coordinate with employees, Traffic Control Managers, clients, vendors, and management. Prepare operational/client reports and provide jobsite hours and information to Sales & Marketing.
* **Wanco Support:** Update Wanco message boards through the website when the Traffic Control Manager is not onsite.

**Qualifications**

* Strong organizational and time-management skills.
* Excellent communication and attention to detail.
* Ability to manage multiple jobs, deadlines, and priorities.
* Proficient with Microsoft Outlook and comfortable learning technology platforms.
* Experience with Belfry, Motive, Sortly, or similar systems is a plus.
* Traffic control, scheduling, fleet, inventory, or operations experience preferred.
* Ability to maintain accurate records and confidential information.

**Ideal Candidate**

A dependable, detail-oriented team member who can coordinate multiple moving parts, communicate effectively, follow through on assignments, and keep personnel, equipment, vehicles, and job documentation organized and up to date.
