jobs.title: Merchandise Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Your Work Matters**  
This position is responsible for supporting the assigned product groups on a daily basis to ensure product performs according to the financial goals of the company. Works closely with stores, Merchandising, Inventory and Logistics teams, vendors and other support groups on a regular basis to optimize the sales initiative for the assigned product and further enhance customer satisfaction.  
  
**MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Work closely with the stores to ensure they are providing valuable feedback and direction by supporting their calls and requests
* Support assigned Buyer / product group according to the financial goals and objectives of the company
* Ensure that all vendor and product documentation is complete and on file with required departments within the company (Vendor Onboarding, Vendor Buying Agreement, EDI set up, etc.)
* Work directly with vendors (international, domestic, and commodity) to manage purchase orders (i.e. logistics, distribution, discrepancies, etc.). Engage management and stores to make sure all data is current and up to date (new SKU setup (collection, keying and managing), SKU data integrity (cost and retail uploads)
* Responsible for timely and accurate data entry of purchase orders, proformas, and vendor information on a daily basis.
* Track international and domestic orders (new store and replenished orders), F&D Express, Special Order purchases and Opportunity Buy’s for the stores
* Research and reconcile invoice and receiving discrepancies; coordinate with the accounting department all account and payment information needed on a vendor basis
* Play a key role in product line review, research analysis, preparation, presentation, review, selection and implementation

**MINIMUM ELIGIBILITY REQUIREMENTS**

* Bachelor’s degree in General Business or related field (relevant experience can be substituted for the required education on the basis of one calendar year of experience for one academic year of education)
* One to four years in one or more of the following areas: purchasing, buying, merchandising, brand management, marketing, store operations or related field
* Account management experience a plus
* Excellent communication skills (oral and written)
* Strong computer skills including Microsoft Office Suite (Intermediate to advanced level Excel required)
* Must be detail oriented and highly organized
* Ability to multi-task, meet deadlines, and work in a fast-paced environment
* Possess excellent customer service skills and work well under pressure

WORKING CONDITIONS (TRAVEL, HOURS, ENVIRONMENT)

  

* Limited travel required including air and car travel
* The noise level in the work environment is typically quiet.

PHYSICAL/SENSORY REQUIREMENTS  
Sedentary Work – Ability to exert 10 - 20 pounds of force occasionally, and/or negligible amount of force frequently to lift, carry, push, pull or otherwise move objects. Sedentary work involves sitting most of the time, but may involve walking or standing for brief periods of time.  
  
NOTE: All duties and responsibilities listed are considered to be essential job functions and requirements, and are subject to possible modification to reasonably accommodate individuals with disabilities. Marginal functions of the position (those that are incidental to the performance of fundamental job duties) have not been included. However, the omission of specific statements of duties does not exclude them from the position if the work is similar, related or logical assignment to the position.  
  
This job description does not constitute an employment agreement between the employer and the employee, and is subject to change by the employer as the needs of the business and requirement of the job change.

**Benefits & Rewards**

Bonus opportunities & career advancement opportunities at every level

Programs that help you reach your financial goals: 401k with company match, Employee Stock Purchase Plan, and Referral Bonus Program

Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, and other Insurance Plans (subject to eligibility criteria)

Work-life balance, including:

* Paid vacation and sick time for eligible associates
* Paid holidays plus a personal holiday
* Paid Volunteer Time Off that starts on Day 1

**Equal Employment Opportunity**

Floor & Decor provides equal employment opportunities to all associates and applicants without regard to age, race, color, religion or creed, national origin or ancestry, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, disability, veteran status, genetic information, ethnicity, citizenship, or any other category protected by law.

This policy applies to all areas of employment, including recruitment, testing, screening, hiring, selection for training, upgrading, transfer, demotion, layoff, discipline, termination, compensation, benefits and all other privileges, terms and conditions of employment. This policy and the law prohibit employment discrimination against any associate or applicant on the basis of any legally protected status outlined above.

jobs.title: Merchandise Coordinator
jobs.description:
TJ Maxx

At TJX Companies, every day brings new opportunities for growth, exploration, and achievement. You’ll be part of our vibrant team that embraces diversity, fosters collaboration, and prioritizes your development. Whether you’re working in our four global Home Offices, Distribution Centers or Retail Stores—TJ Maxx, Marshalls, Homegoods, Homesense, Sierra, Winners, and TK Maxx, you’ll find abundant opportunities to learn, thrive, and make an impact. Come join our TJX family—a Fortune 100 company and the world’s leading off-price retailer.

**Job Description:**

**Opportunity: Grow Your Career**

Responsible for executing receiving and merchandising standards while ensuring Associates are processing efficiently and effectively, and working as a team. Ensures an excellent customer experience by engaging and interacting with all customers, and maintaining a clean and organized store. Role models exceptional customer service.

* Creates a positive internal and external customer experience
* Promotes a culture of honesty and integrity; maintains confidentiality
* Orchestrates truck delivery, prioritizing the processing of merchandise onto the sales floor
* Trains and mentors Associates on established merchandising and processing principles
* Ensures merchandise is properly tagged, hung, secured, and coded
* Communicates with the Coordinator on Duty to ensure efficient flow of goods to sales floor
* Ensures Associates complete tasks and activities according to store plan; prioritizes as needed
* Monitors productivity of team and coaches as necessary
* Organizes and rotates back stock for easy replenishment
* Maintains and upholds merchandising philosophy and signage standards
* Maintains all organizational, cleanliness and recovery standards for the backroom area
* Ensures compliance with recycling and, where applicable, hazardous waste programs
* Communicates accurately and effectively with management and Associates when setting and addressing priorities; provides progress updates
* Provides and accepts recognition and constructive feedback
* Partners with Management on Associate training needs to increase effectiveness
* Ensures adherence to all labor laws, policies, and procedures
* Promotes credit and loyalty programs
* Supports and participates in store shrink reduction goals and programs
* Promotes safety awareness and maintains a safe environment
* Other duties as assigned

**Who We’re Looking For: You.**

* Able to work a flexible schedule, including nights and weekends
* Superior communication and organizational skills with attention to detail
* Capable of multi-tasking
* Able to respond appropriately to changes in direction or unexpected situations
* Team player, working effectively with peers and supervisors
* Capable of lifting heavy objects with or without reasonable accommodation
* Able to train others
* 1 year retail and 6 months of leadership experience

Benefits include: Associate discount; EAP; smoking cessation; bereavement; 401(k) Associate contributions; child care & cell phone discounts; pet & legal insurance; credit union; referral bonuses. Those who meet service or hours requirements are also eligible for: 401(k) match; medical/dental/vision; HSA; health care FSA; life insurance; short/long term disability; paid parental leave; paid holidays/vacation/sick; auto/home insurance discounts; scholarship program; adoption assistance. All benefits are provided in accordance with and subject to the terms of the applicable plan or program and may change from time to time. Contact your TJX representative for more information.

In addition to our open door policy and supportive work environment, we also strive to provide a competitive salary and benefits package. TJX considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, gender identity and expression, marital or military status, or based on any individual's status in any group or class protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. TJX also provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities in accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act and applicable state and local law.

Applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment.

**Address:**

1 Buckhead Loop

**Location:**

USA TJ Maxx Store 0181 Atlanta GAThis position has a starting pay range of USD $14.25 to $14.75 per hour. Actual starting pay is determined by a number of factors, including relevant skills, qualifications, and experience.

**Social Media Coordinator II**

**Posting Expires: October 16, 2026**

**Salary: $50,000 - $55,000/annually**

**General Description and Classification Standards:**

The City of Atlanta Department of Parks & Recreation (DPR) is currently hiring a Social Media Coordinator. We are seeking a highly creative, engaged and detail-oriented candidate to support the management of DPR-owned social media channels to promote parks and recreational programs, events, facilities, and initiatives. They will work closely with the DPR Communications Team to create engaging content, manage social media accounts, and interact with the community online.

The successful candidate should possess excellent verbal and written skills with an in-depth knowledge of the functions of social media and the social media platforms used by DPR (Instagram, Facebook, X [Twitter]). They should also be committed to staying on top of social media trends and innovations to incorporate best practices into their work.

As a member of this dynamic office, the Social Media Coordinator II will work closely with the wider Communications Team to create, source, and adapt content for publications on all DPR platforms. This role reports to the Marketing and Promotions Manager. If you are passionate about parks, recreation, and the strategic use of social media to reach our communities, we want you on our team!

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:** *These are typical responsibilities for this position and should not be construed as exclusive or all inclusive*

* Support the development and implementation of social media strategies to increase awareness and engagement with DPR programming and events.
* Create weekly creative content for social media platforms.
* Regularly travel to parks, park and recreation facilities, and event sites (multiple times per week) to capture original photo and video content, ensuring authentic representation of the department.
* Work flexible shifts, including creating, capturing, and publishing content at activities and events that take place in the evenings, at night, and on weekends.
* Manage social media accounts by scheduling posts, engaging with community members, responding to inquiries, and fostering positive relationships with stakeholders online.
* Work closely with the Communications Team to align social media efforts with overall messaging priorities.
* Monitor current events, trends and best practices in social media marketing and incorporate innovative ideas into the DPR social media strategy.
* Ability to collaborate effectively in a team-oriented environment.
* Attend and participate in department and community programs and events, capture and draft content for social media platforms and other communication channels.
May perform other duties as assigned.  

*The above statements reflect the general duties, responsibilities and competencies considered necessary to perform the essential duties and responsibilities of the job and should not be considered as a detailed description of all the work requirements of the position. COA may change the specific job duties with or without prior notice based on the needs of the organization.*

jobs.title: Marketing Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Marketing Coordinator**
-------------------------

**Reports to:** VP of Marketing

**Location:** Atlanta, GA or Pensacola, FL

### **About Us**

Instant Financial is the industry-leading instant pay platform that is changing the way that millions of Americans get paid. With a push of a button on the Instant app, we give employees immediate access to their earned pay or tips after each shift, for free. Employers who pay with Instant significantly boost job applicants, cut turnover, and dramatically reduce absenteeism, transforming them into employers of choice. We're the instant pay platform that is designed for companies that value employee success and well-being, and that's what drives us each day.

### **About the Role**

Instant Financial is hiring a Marketing Coordinator to keep the marketing function running day to day, from event logistics to agency coordination to cross-functional support. This role is the connective tissue of the marketing team: equal parts hands-on execution and organized follow-through, working closely with the VP of Marketing and the Demand Generation Manager to keep projects, partners, and events moving.

### **Responsibilities**

* Lead end-to-end execution for all conferences, trade shows, and sponsorships, including venue logistics, branded materials, and post-event ROI analysis.
* Plan, order, and coordinate event collateral (booth graphics, printed materials, swag) in line with brand guidelines and budget.
* Prep the sales team ahead of each event, confirm attendee lists, staffing assignments, talking points, and lead-capture logistics.
* Maintain the event calendar and post-event recaps (attendance, leads captured, cost vs. budget).
* Serve as the primary point of coordination across Instant's marketing agencies (PR, SEO, design/web, paid media) — track deliverables, deadlines, and open items so nothing falls through the cracks between partners.
* Act as a connective point between Marketing and other business functions — Sales, CX, Product, and Executive Leadership — routing requests, gathering input, and keeping materials and messaging aligned across teams.
* Help maintain internal documentation (Confluence, shared drives) so marketing processes and materials stay current and easy to find.
* Take on ad hoc requests and projects assigned by the VP of Marketing and the Demand Generation Manager, adjusting priorities as business needs shift.
* Provide flexible, hands-on support wherever marketing capacity is stretched thin.

### **Qualifications**

* 2+ years of experience in marketing, event coordination, or project/operations coordination preferred but not required.
* Strong organizational skills; comfortable managing multiple vendors, deadlines, and stakeholders at once.
* Clear, proactive communicator, both internally and with outside agencies and partners.
* Comfortable with hands-on logistics coordination (shipping, travel, booth/event planning).
* Familiarity with marketing tools a plus (HubSpot, project management tools such as ClickUp or Asana, Google Workspace).
* Able to work independently in a fast-changing, resource-constrained environment.
* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a relevant discipline required. Equivalent, hands-on experience may also be considered.

### **What We Can Offer You**

* Professional growth and career development
* Collaborative team environment - everyone has a voice and is encouraged to use it
* Flexible vacation time - we believe in healthy work and family life
* Retirement plan plus company match
* Medical, dental, and vision benefits

jobs.title: Global Air Logistics Operational Key Account Manager
jobs.description:
It's more than a job
  
  
With a sales career at Kuehne+Nagel, you'll drive long-term business success by mastering sales strategies, nurturing customer relationships and identifying new opportunities. But you will also bring relief and peace of mind to pet owners around the world. Because when you do your job, your colleagues around the world are able to build reliable veterinary supply chains that ensure pets get the care they need. At Kuehne+Nagel, our work is about more than we imagine.
  
  
‎
  
  
We are looking for a customer‑focused Global Operational Key Account Manager (OKAM) to manage the operational relationship with strategic global customers. In this role, you will ensure an outstanding customer experience by overseeing end‑to‑end operational delivery across Air and Sea Logistics, acting as the central operational contact and coordinating closely with internal teams.
  
  
As a Global OKAM, you will also take a leading role within the account team, ensuring strong collaboration across Network OKAMs, OKAS, and operational stakeholders to support customer retention and growth.
  
  
How you create impact
  
  

* Build and maintain strong, long‑term relationships with assigned key accounts through regular engagement and feedback
* Act as the main operational point of contact for strategic customers, beyond day‑to‑day operations
* Represent customer operational needs internally and ensure alignment across Air and Sea Logistics
* Clarify, coordinate, and formalize operational requirements in collaboration with relevant internal teams
* Manage operational escalations, including structurally complex issues and claims-related topics
* Drive customer satisfaction, loyalty, and continuous improvement through tailored operational solutions
* Identify cost optimization and efficiency opportunities in collaboration with customers and internal stakeholders
* Support the implementation of new business and operational changes by leveraging account knowledge and operational expertise
* Lead and coordinate the Operational Key Account Team assigned to the account, ensuring effective governance, reporting, and collaboration
* Proactively work with sales, operations, and customers to address performance issues and implement corrective actions
* Perform customer‑specific operational analysis and support compliance with regulatory requirements

What we would like you to bring
  
  

* Strong experience in freight forwarding and logistics operations, within Air Logistics and/or Sea Logistics
* Proven experience managing operational relationships with complex, multinational customers
* Solid understanding of import/export processes, security requirements, and forwarding systems
* Experience working across multiple business units and countries in a matrix environment
* Strong customer relationship management, communication, and stakeholder coordination skills
* Analytical mindset with the ability to translate data into operational improvements
* Project‑oriented approach with experience supporting operational or account‑related initiatives

This position is not eligible for employment visa sponsorship. Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis without the need for current or future employer sponsorship.
  
  
What's in it for you
  
  
Kuehne+Nagel we strive daily to inspire, empower, and deliver not only to our customers, but also to our colleagues. We offer a dynamic global work environment with opportunities for excellent training programs and career mobility. Base wage is part of a competitive total rewards package that includes health and welfare benefits, a 401k retirement savings plan, tuition reimbursement, and incentive compensation for eligible roles. Individual pay may vary from the target range and is determined by a number of factors including experience, skills, job location, internal pay equity, and other relevant business considerations. Kuehne+Nagel reviews pay ranges regularly to ensure competitive and fair pay based on industry market data. #LI-UT1
  
  
Kuehne+Nagel participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S. Employers can only use E-Verify once you have accepted a job offer and completed the Form I-9.
  
  
Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools may be used to assist in specific processes [e.g. screening applications, interview scheduling]. These tools analyze information to support decision-making, but final decisions are made by human reviewers.
  
  
Who we are
  
  
Logistics shapes everyday life - from the goods we consume to the healthcare we rely on. At Kuehne+Nagel, your work goes beyond logistics; it enables both ordinary and special moments in the lives of people around the world.
  
As a global leader with a strong heritage and a vision to move the world forward, we offer a safe, stable environment where your career can make a real difference. Whether we help deliver life-saving medicines, develop sustainable transportation solutions or support our local communities, your career will contribute to more than you can imagine.

jobs.title: Strategic Account Manager - OEM & Automation Partnerships
jobs.description:
**Purpose of Role**

The Strategic Account Manager – OEM & Automation Partnerships is responsible for securing early engagement with automation OEMs, system integrators, and technology partners that influence packaging specifications and automated warehouse design decisions. Through targeted account penetration, relationship development, and proactive business development, this role creates qualified pipeline, advances specification opportunities, and expands Rehrig's footprint within strategic automation accounts.

Success is measured by pipeline growth, specification wins, OEM relationship development, platform adoption, and revenue growth generated through automation partnerships.

* **Candidate must live within 90 minutes of a manufacturing plant, in Buckeye, AZ, Kenosha, WI, Orlando, FL, Eerie, PA, Atlanta, GA or Dallas, TX.**

**Areas of Accountability**

**Strategic Account Penetration & Relationship Development**

* Develop and execute engagement strategies for assigned OEMs, system integrators, and automation technology providers and Customer end-users.
* Establish relationships with decision-makers, influencers, and specification owners across engineering, solutions, operations, product management, commercial, and executive functions.
* Develop a thorough understanding of customer business models, automation initiatives, growth priorities, and organizational dynamics.
* Position Rehrig as a trusted partner while maintaining relationships that support specification influence, account expansion, and long-term growth within assigned organizations.

**Pipeline Creation & Specification Advancement**

* Generate qualified pipeline through proactive prospecting, account penetration, relationship development, and industry engagement.
* Identify, qualify, and advance opportunities for specification inclusion, platform validation, pilot programs, preferred supplier positioning, and automation deployments through structured pursuit planning.
* Engage customers early in project lifecycles to position Rehrig solutions before formal procurement activity begins.
* Maintain disciplined CRM management, customer data hygiene, relationship mapping, forecasting accuracy, opportunity progression, and sales process compliance to improve commercial visibility and decision-making.

**Opportunity Development & Commercial Execution**

* Align Rehrig products, services, and technical capabilities with customer requirements by coordinating Product Management, Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, Operations, and Commercial resources.
* Coordinate demonstrations, testing, validation activities, proof-of-concept efforts, and customer evaluations that support opportunity advancement and commercial adoption.
* Coordinate the transition of newly awarded business into execution by aligning customer expectations, internal stakeholders, deliverables, and ownership.
* Capture customer requirements, market challenges, and competitive insights that improve opportunity conversion and customer outcomes.
* Expand Rehrig's position within assigned accounts through additional applications, platform adoption, and multi-product solution growth.

**Knowledge, Skills & Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Logistics, or related field; equivalent experience considered.
* 5+ years of experience in business development, strategic sales, automation, intralogistics, material handling, packaging, or related industrial markets.
* Proven success developing new business opportunities and penetrating complex customer organizations within technical or solution-based selling environments.
* Demonstrated ability to build relationships across engineering, operational, commercial, and executive stakeholder groups.
* Experience managing long-cycle, multi-stakeholder opportunities involving technical evaluation, specification influence, and business justification.
* Working knowledge of warehouse automation, robotics, material handling systems, reusable packaging, supply chain technologies, or related solutions preferred.
* Experience engaging automation OEMs, system integrators, robotics providers, material handling organizations, or large-scale distribution operations strongly preferred.
* Strong communication, presentation, negotiation, relationship-building, and consultative selling skills.
* Proficiency with Salesforce, Microsoft 365, sales intelligence platforms, and AI-enabled business tools.
* Willingness to travel approximately 50-70%, including air travel and regional driving.
* Ability to lift and handle products as required for customer demonstrations, trade shows, and field-based activities.

jobs.title: Internal Account Manager (INS852)
jobs.description:
We're looking for an **Internal Account Manager** to own client relationships at Hire Overseas, a fast-moving offshore staffing and HR platform placing vetted global talent into U.S. companies. You will be the primary point of contact for a portfolio of clients, keeping placements on track, resolving issues before they escalate, and ensuring clients stay engaged and satisfied long after the initial hire.

This is a small business. There is no large team behind you and no playbook for every situation. You will have a high degree of ownership and autonomy, which means you make real decisions, handle real problems, and have a direct impact on whether clients stay and grow. If you are a confident communicator who takes ownership instinctively, moves fast when something needs attention, and wants a role where your judgment actually matters, this role is a strong fit.

**Why You'll Want to Join**

* **100% remote setup** so you can work wherever you're most productive
* This role requires availability during **US business hours**
* Work directly with founders at a growing offshore staffing company with real traction and a strong client base
* High-ownership role with full autonomy over how you manage and grow your client portfolio

**What You'll Work On**

**Client Relationship Management**

* Own a portfolio of client accounts as the primary point of contact from placement through ongoing engagement
* Build strong, trust-based relationships that make clients feel supported and well-served
* Conduct regular check-ins and proactively surface any issues, risks, or opportunities before they become problems
* Keep clients informed, engaged, and confident in their placements without waiting for them to reach out first

**Issue Resolution and Escalation**

* Handle client concerns quickly and professionally, taking ownership of resolution rather than routing everything to someone else
* Identify patterns in client feedback and flag systemic issues to leadership with recommended fixes
* Coordinate internally across recruiting, operations, and leadership to resolve complex client situations
* Make judgment calls on when to escalate and when to handle directly

**Retention and Growth**

* Drive client retention by delivering a consistently high-quality account management experience
* Identify opportunities to expand relationships including additional placements, new roles, or expanded scope
* Track account health and flag at-risk clients early with a clear plan of action

**Reporting and Communication**

* Maintain accurate and current records of all client interactions, account status, and open items
* Provide regular internal updates on portfolio health, client sentiment, and key risks
* Communicate clearly and professionally in writing and on calls across all client and internal interactions

**What You Bring**

* Proven experience in account management, client success, or a similar client-facing role in a B2B environment
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills with a professional and responsive style
* High ownership mindset — you take responsibility for outcomes rather than passing problems up or sideways
* Comfortable operating with autonomy in a small business environment where processes are still being built and the answers are not always obvious
* Organized and detail-oriented with the ability to manage multiple client accounts simultaneously without losing track of anything
* Proactive and fast-moving with a bias toward action over deliberation when clients need support

**Nice to Have**

* Experience in staffing, recruiting, HR services, or workforce management
* Background working at a small business, startup, or founder-led company
* Familiarity with offshore or global hiring and the dynamics of remote contractor placements
* Experience with CRM tools for tracking client interactions and account health

**How to Apply**

Please include:

* Your **updated resume**
* A **short Loom video (1 to 2 minutes)** introducing yourself, describing your account management or client success experience, and walking through how you handle a situation where a client is unhappy and you have to resolve it without escalating to leadership

**Only candidates who submit a Loom video will be moved to the next step of the hiring process.**

If you want full ownership over a client portfolio at a fast-moving company where your decisions actually matter and your impact is directly visible, this role gives you the autonomy and the scope to do your best work.

**Application Process Overview**

Our comprehensive selection process ensures we find the right fit for both you and our clients:

* **Initial Application** - Submit your application and complete our prequalifying questions
* **Video Introduction** - Record an video introduction to showcase your communication skills and work experience
* **Role-Specific Assessment** - Complete a homework assignment tailored to the position (if applicable)

jobs.description:
About the Opportunity:

Are you ready to be a catalyst for growth and a builder of lasting relationships? At SRM Concrete, we believe that every handshake, every conversation, and every promise kept helps build the foundation of America’s future. We’re searching for a passionate, driven Sales Representative—someone who sees every challenge as an opportunity and every customer as a partner on the journey to excellence.

Whether you’re a seasoned sales professional with deep industry connections or a service-minded individual eager to make a difference, your energy, integrity, and commitment to serving others are what matter most. * Inspire and represent: Be the face of SRM Concrete at networking events and in the community, sharing our story and our commitment to service.
* Lift others up: Support your teammates, share your knowledge, and help everyone around you achieve their best.

What Sets You Apart:

* Passion for delivering outstanding customer service and building lasting relationships.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills; you connect easily with customers, contractors, and teammates.
* Self-motivated, organized, and able to manage your schedule and priorities independently in a fast-paced environment.
* Eager to learn and grow—whether it’s new products, industry trends, or customer needs.
* Tech-savvy and comfortable using CRM systems, digital tools, and Microsoft Office Suite.
* Experience in sales, customer service, or the construction/building materials industry is helpful, but a positive attitude and willingness to learn are most important.
* Ability to identify opportunities, solve problems, and turn challenges into wins.
* Commitment to upholding SRM Concrete’s values of service, integrity, and teamwork in every interaction.
* Valid driver’s license and willingness to travel locally to job sites and customer locations.
* Ability to work both independently and as part of a collaborative team, with exposure to office, field, and job site environments.

About SRM:

SRM Concrete (Smyrna Ready Mix) is a family-owned, values-driven leader in the ready mix concrete industry. Founded in 1999 with a single plant in Smyrna, Tennessee, we’ve grown to over 600 locations nationwide by focusing on quality, integrity, and service. Our mission is to serve our customers, our communities, and our team members with excellence—every load, every day.

### **Why Join SRM Concrete?**

* **Growth & Advancement:** Be part of a rapidly expanding company where your ambition and drive can take you as far as you want to go. Our sales team is at the forefront of our growth, and we invest in your professional development every step of the way.

* **Exceptional Benefits:** Low-cost medical, dental, vision, STD, LTD, and life insurance; paid holidays; PTO/vacation; 401k with $100 weekly match; family days; and more!
* **Team Culture:** We value hard work, respect, and teamwork. We support each other, recognize a job well done, and believe in doing what’s right—on the job and in the community. You’ll find a straightforward, dependable environment where every team member matters.

jobs.title: Outside Sales Representative

Welcome to Gordon Food Service! We are excited that you are thinking about opportunities with us, and we have an amazing story to share. See below for a quick glance of who we are and the impact you could have on the food service industry. There's a seat at our table for you...

**Overview**
============

For over 125 years, Gordon Food Service has delivered the excellence, expertise, and quality products our customers need to design successful food operations and experiences. We've grown to be the largest family-operated broadline food distribution company in North America by being passionately committed to the people we serve.

  
  

At Gordon Food Service, our customers come first. As an Outside Food Sales Representative, you will cultivate relationships, develop new business, and provide innovative solutions to our customers, helping them to achieve their goals and, in return, yours!

  

This position will reside in: **Atlanta, GA.**

  

**This position will be located ITP between Buckhead and Decatur.**

  

**Position Benefits**
=====================

* A generous 401(k) matching program that is above industry standards
* Financial rewards for performance compensation structure which includes salary, commission, and bonuses
* Low-cost benefit options for you and your family's health and future
* An Automobile expense reimbursement plan
* Cell phone reimbursement plan
  

  

**Outside Food Sales Representative**
=====================================

We invite you to join our sales team where you’ll experience a world where servant leadership and cutting-edge tools and training come together to support your career growth and financial objectives.

  
  

As an Outside Food Sales Representative, you’ll be responsible for the overall sales and relationship management efforts for existing and prospective customers within your assigned territory. This includes pursuing new customers, deepening and strengthening existing customer relationships, and sales territory management.

  
  

**Pursuing New Customers**
--------------------------

* Researching industry and market trends impacting restaurants within your territory
* Identifying and researching prospective customers within your territory
* Developing sales strategies that highlight products, services, values, and solutions offered by Gordon Food Service and presenting the sales strategy to prospective customers
  

  

**Deepen and Strengthen Existing Customer Relationships**
---------------------------------------------------------

* Visiting all customers within the assigned territory on a weekly, bi-weekly, or monthly basis
* Conducting business reviews to determine existing customers needs and areas of opportunity for growing sales
* Providing ongoing training to customers on Gordon Food Service product offerings
* Identifying opportunities within existing customers businesses where Gordon Food Service can add value through product and service offerings
  

  

**Sales Territory Management**

* Balancing new customers acquisition and deepening and strengthening existing customer relationships
* Coordinating visits to prospective customers and existing customers
* Communicating order status and order processing updates to customers
  

  

**Sales Training - Getting you Ready**
======================================

Gordon Food Service’s goal during your first 90 days is to set you up for success! This includes engaging you in various training offerings, including e-learning, classroom sessions, video roleplays, job shadowing, and peer sales representative mentorship. Throughout your first 90 days, you will learn:

* How to use Gordon Food Service systems, processes, and tools to manage customer relationships
* About the products available to Gordon Food Service customers
* The sales process for engaging new customers
* How to establish your relationships in the vast network of resources available to you, a Gordon Food Service sales representative
* Best practices on developing relationships with current and prospective customers
* Strategies on how to effectively manage your territory
  

  

**Position Requirements**
=========================

* High School Diploma/GED is required
* Bachelor's degree and/or culinary certificate preferred
* 1 year of prior sales, business, or food service experience
* Maintaining a valid state driver's license and a safe driving record
* Ability to obtain your food safety certification
  

  

Gordon Food Service encourages veterans and active military members to apply

To demonstrate our commitment to our partnership, we will require any candidate who works for a Gordon Food Service customer to provide a letter of support from their management if they are selected for the interview process.

jobs.title: Business Development Representative
jobs.description:
**About Emerald**

Emerald’s talented and experienced teams grow our customers’ businesses 365 days a year with products that create connections, deliver content, and drive commerce. We produce over 140 annual events, create and deliver content through print and digital channels, and power commerce through our seamlessly integrated in-person and digital platforms and channels. For more information, please visit http://www.emeraldx.com.

Forge is looking for a high-energy Business Development pro to help grow revenue across our portfolio of trade shows and conferences. You’ll be the person who finds the right companies to talk to, starts the conversation, and qualifies opportunities for our Account Executives to close.

If you like digging into research, testing what messaging works, and using tools like Gong and Salesforce to build a pipeline, you’ll fit right in. You’ll help create pipeline through modern outbound prospecting — combining research, signal-based targeting, and consultative outreach. This is a fast-paced, “learn by doing” role with clear coaching, measurable goals, and a strong path into an Account Executive career track.

**Location: Alpharetta, GA or New York, NY (Broadway) — hybrid options may be available based on team needs.**

Why this role matters: You’ll create the top of the funnel—turning target accounts into real conversations and qualified meetings that become event and sponsorship revenue.

**Responsibilities**

* Research net-new exhibitor and sponsor accounts using ZoomInfo industry intelligence, and signal-based prospecting (intent, trigger events, engagement signals.
* Build targeted lists and run multi-threaded outreach cadences (email, phone, social) while keeping clean notes and next steps in Salesforce.
* Qualify prospects through short discovery conversations—confirming fit, goals, decision process, and timing—so we focus on high-potential opportunities.
* Create personalized outreach that connects a prospect’s business goals to the value of Forge’s events (ROI, audience, leads, brand visibility).
* Partner closely with Account Executives for a smooth handoff—sharing research, key contacts, conversation notes, and recommended next steps.
* Collaborate with Marketing and attendee teams to share feedback on lead quality, personas, and campaigns—then adjust targeting and messaging accordingly.
* Stay current on industry trends, competitor events, and emerging categories; bring new ideas for who we should be selling to next.
* Occasionally support the close by stepping in to run pricing/package conversations when needed.

**What we’re looking for**

* 0–2 years of experience in sales, customer success, recruiting, fundraising, hospitality, or another role where you had to build relationships and hit goals (internships count).
* Comfortable with outbound outreach (calls + email) and willing to practice, iterate, and get better fast.
* Tech savvy: experience using Salesforce (or another CRM) and confidence learning new tools quickly.
* Organized and self-directed—you can manage a daily outreach plan, follow-ups, and deadlines without things slipping.
* Strong communication skills: you can write clear, professional messages and speak confidently with new people.
* Be a consultative partner! Understand basic discovery methods (BANT) business pain, priorities, stakeholders, and decision process.
* Ability to travel up to 30% (some events require on-site time).

**Success Metrics**

* You will be measured on pipeline created, qualified opportunities, conversion, target account penetration, activity effectiveness.

**Nice to have**

* Experience with Gong, ZoomInfo, sales engagement tools, or list-building tools.
* Comfort with light data analysis (Excel/Google Sheets) to track activity and results.
* Interest in events, media, marketing, or B2B communities—and curiosity about how businesses grow.

**What success looks like (first 90 days)**

*First 30 Days*

* Learn markets, messaging, systems, and outreach standards.

*60 Days*

* Consistently execute outbound cadence and generate qualified meetings.

*90 Days*

* Create repeatable pipeline contribution and begin influencing targeting and messaging.

**About Emerald**

At Emerald, we strive to foster a diverse and inclusive community. We actively recruit and champion candidates who bring new perspectives from varied professional backgrounds and experiences, and we are intentional about ensuring a positive hiring experience for everyone. Our job postings don’t contain experience inflation, and most don’t require college degrees. Instead, they’re crafted to focus on outcomes and transferable experiences that are assessed in a structured interview process carried out by trained hiring teams.

**COMPENSATION & BENEFITS**

Target Compensation: $60,000 plus Sales Incentive Plan eligible

Please note that this range reflects a reasonable estimate of the target compensation for this position. This range may ultimately vary based on a candidate’s qualifications and may be higher where required by applicable law.

We offer a competitive benefits package designed to strengthen our employees’ physical and mental health, including unlimited vacation for exempt employees, flexible working locations, 401(k) plan with a company match, medical/dental/vision coverage with inclusive provisions including transgender services and fertility benefits, parental and caregiver leave, dependent, commuter and FSA benefits, professional development programs like Toastmasters, and mental wellness tools.

If you need accommodation in our application process or have questions about our posted salary range, please email our Talent Acquisition team at Careers@EmeraldX.com.

* Escalate issues to the Field Marketing Manager as needed
* Track and process vendor invoices to ensure timely payment

Whether you’re working in our four global Home Offices, Distribution Centers or Retail Stores—TJ Maxx, Marshalls, Homegoods, Homesense, Sierra, Winners, and TK Maxx, you’ll find abundant opportunities to learn, thrive, and make an impact. * Capable of multi-tasking

Job Summary:

**WHO ARE WE?**

Live Nation Entertainment is the world’s leading live entertainment company, comprised of global market leaders: Ticketmaster, Live Nation Concerts, and Live Nation Media & Sponsorship. Ticketmaster is the global leader in event ticketing with over 620 million tickets sold annually and approximately 10,000 clients worldwide. Live Nation Concerts is the largest provider of live entertainment in the world promoting more than 50,000 events annually for nearly 7,000 artists in 40+ countries. These businesses allow Live Nation Media & Sponsorship to create strategic music marketing programs that connect more than 1,200 sponsors with the 145 million fans that attend Live Nation Entertainment events each year. For additional information, visit www.livenationentertainment.com .

**WHO ARE YOU?**

Passionate and motivated. Driven, with an entrepreneurial spirit. Resourceful, innovative, forward thinking and committed. At Live Nation Entertainment, our people embrace these qualities, so if this sounds like you then please read on!

**THE JOB**

We are currently looking for a Coordinator of Regional Marketing. In this role, under the guidance of the Regional Marketing Management Team, you’ll be responsible for multiple marketing efforts including artist and audience research, coordination, and delivery of marketing assets to marketing partners, invoice coding and payment and event marketing recap reports.

**WHAT THIS ROLE WILL DO**

* Perform a range of administrative and marketing support duties for the Regional Marketing Management Team
* Coordinate the delivery of promotional tickets with applicable marketing partners throughout the region
* Compile advertising settlement recap reports for locally booked events
* Code and process incoming advertising invoices
* Research audience and artist demographic info to help shape marketing plans
* Research media performance statistics to inform marketing strategy
* Work with internal teams to create impactful marketing campaigns on various digital platforms
* Assist with any grassroots marketing campaigns (ordering flyers/posters, shipping materials)
* Assist the local sponsorship team with annual local sponsorship marketing recaps
* Assist the local PR team in compiling press requests to coordinate event media coverage
* Ensure all necessary show marketing information is input into Live Nation proprietary marketing tools
* Day of show event coverage as necessary
* Ability to work extended hours, including weekends and evenings is required (as dictated by show dates, deadlines, etc.)

Assist in additional duties as needed  



**WHAT THIS PERSON WILL BRING**

* Bachelor’s degree in marketing or a related field preferred, but not required
* 1+ years of prior experience in event assisting/planning or marketing experience within an entertainment, sports or public assembly facility setting
* Extensive music knowledge: event planning, concert or sports marketing experience preferred
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail
* Ability to thrive in a fast-paced & high-volume environment
* Ability to troubleshoot and problem solve independently
* Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written
* Strong collaboration skills - can work well with navigating various stakeholders and teams
* Ability to work day, evening, and weekend hours, based on the needs of daily business operations

Willingness to travel as needed

**CAREER** : Career and skill development programs with School of Live, tuition reimbursement, and student loan repayment

jobs.title: Commercial Account Manager
jobs.description:
**A path for every ambition.**

At HUB, we believe the best work happens when people are given real space to grow and then given the autonomy to exercise it. We power progress and protect ambition: for the clients who count on us, and equally for the people who make that possible every day.

We’re creative thinkers and determined doers, guided by values that show up in how we work together: with empathy, adaptability, accountability and a genuine commitment to one another’s success. We foster bold ideas, celebrate curiosity and share what we know. Because when people grow, the work they do grows with them.

Our purpose is deeply human: to help people navigate the world on their terms, at their speed, toward their future. We hold that same commitment to the people building careers here.

Whether you’re starting out or leveling up, you’ll find the resources to evolve, the support to take on more and a team ready to back you at every stage.

Your ambition has a home here.

**About Specialty Program Group:**

Our goal is to partner with industry-leading specialty businesses to provide them with the ability to achieve their goals and optimize their businesses. Specialty Program Group offers access to capital and investment, deep carrier relationships, creative thinking, product development and broad distribution, while allowing our businesses to maintain the essence of what makes them successful. Specialty Program Group delivers leading-edge specialty expertise backed by transformative digital capabilities and sophisticated data and analytics.

A pioneer in insurance technology, Insureon operates the largest online insurance marketplace for small businesses in the U.S. Our proprietary technology platform enables business owners to easily compare and purchase the insurance they need. We also license this platform to select industry participants who are looking to more eAectively service their own clients. We are integrated with every major U.S. carrier, manage over $400M in premium annually and are licensed in all 50 states.

We place a high value on having fun at work, personal and company integrity and teamwork, and we believe our success is truly a team sport. We foster a service mentality inside and outside our company and our fast-paced team is driven by results and is energetic about servicing our clients.

We are looking for a Digital Account Manager to join our firm. The Account Manager will be responsible for the ongoing management of commercial clients, retention of new and renewal clients, and maintaining a partnership with carriers to support business development activities while upholding high service standards.

This position can be located anywhere in the US.

**Essential Functions and Responsibilities;**

* Independently manages accounts on a day-to-day basis which includes coordinating all services, answering all questions, and resolving problems, which may arise; maintains timeliness and completeness when interacting with clients
* Negotiates and secures the most appropriate carrier coverage based upon client needs for new and renewal business and negotiating cost of those coverages; maintains ongoing relationships with carrier product managers.
* Makes decisions regarding the resolution of all moderate and complex customer service problems: research and resolve coverage issues, audit issues, billing discrepancies in a timely manner.
* Solely responsible for ensuring all the terms and conditions of the insurance policies written by the insurance company are properly prepared and provides all of the coverage that was presented to the insured.
* Uses specific industry training and knowledge to determine the needs of the client and identify cross-selling opportunities; expands/rounds-out existing accounts by identifying potential gaps in coverage, recommending and implementing proper coverage.
* Research and maintains industry knowledge of developing trends regarding carrier underwriting, appetite and pricing changes. Applies knowledge to negotiation of policies to provide best comprehensive coverage to clients.
* Solely responsible for having an understanding of assigned accounts in order to give proper advice for changing situations, which may require modifications to existing coverage.

· Collaboration with the Associate Account Managers to ensure that basic Client Services tasks have been completed and all renewal documentation is complete. · Other duties may be assigned to meet business needs.

* At least 3 years of Commercial Lines Account Management experience
* Familiar with Customer Account Servicing
* Demonstrated success in customer service skills
* Demonstrates highest level technical and cognitive abilities to ensure accuracy, precision and execute client requests on time
* Ability to understand and manage complex accounts while working under tight timeframes
* Ability to follow processes and procedures and help develop new processes and procedures to help the company become more eAicient
* Must possess the ability to work independently, applying education and professional experience to achieve outstanding results

Word processing, spreadsheets, email software and other related programs. Comfortable working with 3rd Party or Agency management systems, Various Web Applications, Client or Insureon Agent portals and other related online applications.

This role requires sitting at a workstation for extended periods of time, while working in a dedicated oAice space in your home environment.

jobs.description:
**About Grubhub**

At Grubhub, we believe food is more than just a meal: It’s a source of discovery, connection, and pure enjoyment. There’s a time and place for every type of dish, from hidden neighborhood gems to tried-and-true favorites, and we exist to connect people with the food they love in all the ways they like to dig in. We’ve been at it since 2004, but now, as part of Wonder, Grubhub is operating with a renewed sense of momentum and the high-velocity energy of a powerhouse startup.

As a leading U.S. ordering and delivery marketplace, we feature over 415,000 merchants in more than 4,000 cities, creating the ultimate food experience by elevating online ordering through innovative restaurant technology, easy-to-use platforms, and an improved delivery experience. We are constantly finding new ways to innovate—from integrated grocery delivery with groceries powered by Instacart to exclusive loyalty programs. Join our team, based out of New York City and Chicago, and help us give our diners the exceptional value they deserve.

**About The Opportunity**

At Grubhub, we are committed to empowering restaurants and driving growth for our partners. As an Associate Account Manager on the Scaled Accounts team, you will serve as a dedicated advocate and trusted advisor for a portfolio of high-value enterprise restaurant accounts.

In this role, you will play a critical part in protecting merchant sentiment, driving long-term retention, and elevating operational performance across large-scale restaurant brands. You will blend empathetic communication, data-driven problem-solving, and cross-functional collaboration to turn everyday operational challenges into opportunities for partner growth.

If you are passionate about the restaurant industry, thrive in a fast-paced environment, and enjoy solving complex problems for strategic partners, we encourage you to apply.

  

**The Impact You Will Make**

* Serve as a Consistent Partner: Act as a dedicated, trusted contact for enterprise restaurant accounts, helping owners and operators feel supported and confident in their Grubhub partnership.
* Build Trust Through Communication: Establish strong relationships with partners by actively listening, anticipating operational needs, and providing clear, dependable follow-through.
* Turn Metrics into Action: Review important metrics to help restaurant partners spot operational wins, challenges, and opportunities to grow their business.
* Guide Issues to Resolution: Independently triage everyday merchant challenges from menu and account updates to payment or logistics questions, and collaborate thoughtfully with internal teams to resolve them.
* Help Merchants Grow: Share personalized recommendations on marketing tools, promotions, and platform features to help partners reach new diners and boost order volume.
* Offer Flexible Support: Provide tailored guidance when unique situations require creative flexibility beyond standard operating procedures. Use phone, email, video calls, and internal tools seamlessly to communicate in whatever way best supports the merchant.
* Collaborate Across Teams: Partner closely with internal teams to deliver coordinated, high-quality support.
* Maintain Operational Quality: Confidently navigate internal systems like Salesforce and document updates clearly to ensure clean account records and seamless service continuity.
Stay Curious & Adaptable: Approach new processes, tools, and pilot initiatives with curiosity and strong judgment, offering constructive feedback to continuously improve team workflows.  

  

**What You Bring to the Table**

* 1–2+ years of experience in Account Management, Customer Success, Merchant Operations, or Client-Facing Support (experience working with restaurants or in high-volume SaaS/Marketplace environments is a strong plus)
* Technical Aptitude: Tech-savvy with experience using CRMs (Salesforce, Zendesk), workflow tools (Jira), and standard productivity suites (MS Office, Google Workspace).
* Enterprise Mindset & Customer Empathy: A strong, human-centered approach to client management with a passion for advocating for restaurant owners and resolving complex inquiries under pressure.
* Informed Problem Solving: Ability to assess complex partner needs, trace issues to their root causes, and use performance data to tell a compelling story and drive solutions.
* Clear & Professional Communication: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills; comfortable conducting high-touch phone check-ins, delivering executive-level updates, and managing difficult partner conversations with polish and tact.
* Operational Adaptability: Proven ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced, evolving ecosystem while consistently meeting turnaround expectations and quality standards.

jobs.title: Internal Account Manager (INS852)
jobs.description:
We're looking for an **Internal Account Manager** to own client relationships at Hire Overseas, a fast-moving offshore staffing and HR platform placing vetted global talent into U.S. companies. You will be the primary point of contact for a portfolio of clients, keeping placements on track, resolving issues before they escalate, and ensuring clients stay engaged and satisfied long after the initial hire.

This is a small business. There is no large team behind you and no playbook for every situation. You will have a high degree of ownership and autonomy, which means you make real decisions, handle real problems, and have a direct impact on whether clients stay and grow. If you are a confident communicator who takes ownership instinctively, moves fast when something needs attention, and wants a role where your judgment actually matters, this role is a strong fit.

**Why You'll Want to Join**

* **100% remote setup** so you can work wherever you're most productive
* This role requires availability during **US business hours**
* Work directly with founders at a growing offshore staffing company with real traction and a strong client base
* High-ownership role with full autonomy over how you manage and grow your client portfolio

**What You'll Work On**

**Client Relationship Management**

* Own a portfolio of client accounts as the primary point of contact from placement through ongoing engagement
* Build strong, trust-based relationships that make clients feel supported and well-served
* Conduct regular check-ins and proactively surface any issues, risks, or opportunities before they become problems
* Keep clients informed, engaged, and confident in their placements without waiting for them to reach out first

**Issue Resolution and Escalation**

* Handle client concerns quickly and professionally, taking ownership of resolution rather than routing everything to someone else
* Identify patterns in client feedback and flag systemic issues to leadership with recommended fixes
* Coordinate internally across recruiting, operations, and leadership to resolve complex client situations
* Make judgment calls on when to escalate and when to handle directly

**Retention and Growth**

* Drive client retention by delivering a consistently high-quality account management experience
* Identify opportunities to expand relationships including additional placements, new roles, or expanded scope
* Track account health and flag at-risk clients early with a clear plan of action

**Reporting and Communication**

* Maintain accurate and current records of all client interactions, account status, and open items
* Provide regular internal updates on portfolio health, client sentiment, and key risks
* Communicate clearly and professionally in writing and on calls across all client and internal interactions

**What You Bring**

* Proven experience in account management, client success, or a similar client-facing role in a B2B environment
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills with a professional and responsive style
* High ownership mindset — you take responsibility for outcomes rather than passing problems up or sideways
* Comfortable operating with autonomy in a small business environment where processes are still being built and the answers are not always obvious
* Organized and detail-oriented with the ability to manage multiple client accounts simultaneously without losing track of anything
* Proactive and fast-moving with a bias toward action over deliberation when clients need support

**Nice to Have**

* Experience in staffing, recruiting, HR services, or workforce management
* Background working at a small business, startup, or founder-led company
* Familiarity with offshore or global hiring and the dynamics of remote contractor placements
* Experience with CRM tools for tracking client interactions and account health

**How to Apply**

Please include:

* Your **updated resume**
* A **short Loom video (1 to 2 minutes)** introducing yourself, describing your account management or client success experience, and walking through how you handle a situation where a client is unhappy and you have to resolve it without escalating to leadership

**Only candidates who submit a Loom video will be moved to the next step of the hiring process.**

If you want full ownership over a client portfolio at a fast-moving company where your decisions actually matter and your impact is directly visible, this role gives you the autonomy and the scope to do your best work.

**Application Process Overview**

Our comprehensive selection process ensures we find the right fit for both you and our clients:

* **Initial Application** - Submit your application and complete our prequalifying questions
* **Video Introduction** - Record an video introduction to showcase your communication skills and work experience
* **Role-Specific Assessment** - Complete a homework assignment tailored to the position (if applicable)
* **Recruitment Interview** - Initial screening with our talent team
* **Executive Interview** - Meet with senior leadership to discuss role alignment
* **Client Interview** - Final interview with the client team you'd be supporting
* **Background & Reference Check** - Professional reference verification
* **Job Offer** - Successful candidates receive a formal offer to join the team

Each stage is designed to evaluate your fit for the role while giving you insights into our company culture and expectations.

We'll keep you informed throughout the process and provide feedback at each step.

jobs.title: Entry Level Account Manager
jobs.description:
US Energy is an Energy Brokerage firm based in the Chicago land area. US Energy specializes in Brokering Energy and offering Energy Supply initiatives for Business Class Customers in the state of Illinois. We are opening 5 more national offices by the end of 2027- each will be run by an executive who started in our entry level account manager position and progressed through our training into management. We find that candidates with sports backgrounds have valuable skill sets due to their work ethic, competitive drive, and ability to win in all types of situations.

This is a hands-on opportunity for someone who is competitive, driven, personable, and eager to learn. While sales is at the core of the position, our team members gain exposure to campaign management, recruiting, human resources, leadership, and team development.

If you’re someone who enjoys a fast-paced environment, thrives on goals, and wants a clear path for growth, this could be the opportunity for you. We believe in promoting from within. Our goal is to develop talented people into successful sales professionals and future leaders.

**Why Join Us?**

* Opportunity for career advancement within a growing company.
* Comprehensive training and professional development programs.
* Supportive and energetic team environment.
* Competitive compensation and performance-based bonuses.
* Exposure to leadership and strategic business planning.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Develop and maintain strong relationships with clients.
* Execute effective sales strategies to achieve revenue targets and expand market share.
* Negotiate contracts and agreements with clients to ensure mutual satisfaction.
* Collaborate with team members to create innovative marketing campaigns that drive engagement.
Stay informed about industry trends and competitor activities to identify new opportunities.  

  
  
**Requirements**  

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in sales, marketing, business, or a related field
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills
* Competitive, motivated, and results-oriented mindset
* Ability to build relationships and communicate confidently with clients
* Strong organizational and time-management skills
* Ability to work independently while contributing to a team
* Willingness to commute to our Schaumburg office
* Previous leadership, management, sales, or recruiting experience is a plus

  
**Benefits**  

* Performance-based bonuses
* Leadership incentives
* Dental insurance
* Blue Cross Blue Shield health insurance available
* Paid training and professional development
* Opportunities for advancement

jobs.description:
Description:

**General Summary:**

This position is responsible for generating new customers and new revenue while promoting our array of bin cleaning and product transfer services, helping agriculture customers at a fiscally responsible level. The ideal candidate requires an aggressive, dedicated professional who applies creativity, passion, and persistence to stop at nothing to grow and close new business.

Positions reporting to this position: None

**Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Apply a high-energy, quick pace approach to aggressively enter the marketplace, have a direct, immediate impact building relationships, penetrating barriers to entry, building relationships, identifying opportunities, and closing business
* Understands how to deliver a targeted elevator pitch to prospects with a focus on planned maintenance work more so than emergency work
* Builds relationships through effective communication with prospects and customers and particularly with key decisionmakers responsible for spending money.
* Develops and plans for project and revenue growth while upholding customer service requirements, driving profitability and expense control
* Serves as an advocate and problem-solver with customers and prospects while having their best interests in mind
* Involved to develop solutions when customers and prospects become reliant on others when equipment or storage challenges arise
* Identifies market trends and customer needs while assessing competitive threats
* Actively and aggressively fills sales opportunity pipeline
* Pass detailed background checks to gain access to company & customer property.
* Performs other incidental and related duties as required.

Requirements:

**Experience Requirements:**

* Five years of related experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Must have experience managing accounts and building relationships with key decisionmakers, responsible for spending money.
* Familiarity in the agriculture industry is a major plus.

**Required Knowledge/ Skills:**

* Proven proficiency to make cold calls to prospects and build productive relationships
* Creative and entrepreneurial flair while engaging in the relentless pursuit of growth
* Skill to make persuasive overtures to prospects resulting in closing new business
* Strong aptitude to learn technical information and communicate our storage cleaning and product transfer processes
* Polished verbal and writing skills, comfort in multi-tasking, aggressive prospecting

jobs.description:
ThinkMarkets is a global financial technology company specializing in multi-asset trading solutions. Through our flagship ThinkTrader platform, we provide clients worldwide with access to thousands of financial instruments across global markets, supported by advanced trading technology and infrastructure.

Backed by ThinkMarkets' market expertise and infrastructure, ThinkCapital is our prop trading evaluation business, providing aspiring traders with access to a broad range of trading products within a simulated trading environment.

Our mission is to simplify the trading journey by combining smart technology with trusted support, giving traders the tools, education and opportunities to develop their skills and elevate their trading potential.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a creative, hands-on Social Media Manager to grow ThinkCapital's social presence, engage trader audiences and build an active online community.

You will plan, create and publish content, manage daily audience interactions and use performance insights to improve results. The role combines social media execution with an understanding of prop trading, trader interests and the content that builds awareness, trust and interest in our evaluation products.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Social Media & Content**

* Plan and execute social media activity across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, X, Facebook, LinkedIn and other relevant platforms.
* Manage the content calendar, aligning posts with product updates, campaigns, promotions and relevant trading themes.
* Create engaging content, including captions, short-form videos, educational posts and community-led content.
* Work with Creative and Marketing teams to produce platform-specific visuals, reels and videos.
* Translate challenge features, evaluation rules and product benefits into clear, accessible content.
* Test new content formats and respond to relevant trends while maintaining a consistent brand voice.

**Community & Engagement**

* Manage daily audience interactions, responding to comments and messages and coordinating customer queries with Support.
* Build and engage trader communities across social platforms and owned channels such as Discord.
* Encourage conversations, gather feedback and identify opportunities for community participation.
* Support collaborations with relevant trading creators, influencers and brand ambassadors.
* Monitor audience sentiment and flag recurring questions or concerns to the relevant teams.

**Performance & Collaboration**

* Track audience growth, engagement, reach, website traffic and conversions from social activity.
* Use performance insights to improve content, publishing schedules and community engagement.
* Monitor competitor activity, trader conversations and platform trends to identify new opportunities.
* Work with Marketing, Product and Support teams on campaigns, launches and community initiatives.
* Ensure content accurately reflects ThinkCapital's products and follows brand, platform and internal approval guidelines.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Journalism or a related field from a recognized, accredited university.
* Hands-on experience managing social channels and creating engaging content.
* Familiarity with short-form video formats, including TikTok, Reels and YouTube Shorts.
* Strong writing skills and the ability to adapt content for different platforms.
* Understanding of audience engagement, community management and social media analytics.

* Experience in prop trading, fintech or trading-related marketing is a plus.
* Experience with Discord, creator collaborations or social media management tools is a plus.
* Examples of content, campaigns or social channels you have worked on.
