jobs.title: Direct Sales Representative (B2B Sales) - Schaumburg, IL
jobs.description:
**Turn Your People Skills Into a Career**

Looking for a career where your attitude, work ethic, and people skills matter more than your previous experience?

**Universal Energy Solutions** is hiring motivated individuals to join our **Schaumburg** team as **Direct Sales Representatives**. Whether you’re just starting your career, changing industries, or looking for a fresh opportunity, this **entry-level** position is designed for people who enjoy working with others and want to build a successful career.

**No previous sales experience? No problem.**

As a **Direct Sales Representative**, you’ll work directly with local business owners to review their electricity and natural gas supply plans, introduce competitive supplier options, and recommend solutions that fit their business needs. During your first several weeks, you’ll focus on developing new business opportunities while learning our proven sales system alongside experienced Account Managers. Their sole focus is to help our newest team members hit the ground running.

**Why This Is a Great Place to Start Your Career**

Many companies expect you to have experience before they’ll give you an opportunity. We believe great sales professionals are developed through training, coaching, and hands-on experience.

During your first several weeks, you’ll work be mentored by an experienced Account Managers who will teach you our proven sales system that’s helped many of our team members build successful careers. You'll get to learn firsthand, what success looks like as you build confidence in your presentations skills and become an expert in our products and services.

As you gain experience, you’ll have opportunities to take on larger customer portfolios, build long-term client relationships, and advance into **Account Manager** and other leadership positions. We’re committed to promoting from within as part of our goal to continually expand into 20+ additional markets over the next few years.

**What You’ll Do**

Your day begins at the office, where you'll work with your mentor to plan, prepare and strategize for the day ahead. You'll then head into your assigned territory and crush your goals. From there, you control the tone and outcome of your day. Responsibilities include:

* Meet face-to-face with business owners and decision-makers.
* Review current electricity and natural gas supply plans.
* Help businesses identify opportunities to reduce their energy costs.
* Recommend competitive energy supplier options based on each customer’s needs.
* Build relationships with prospective commercial customers.
* Learn our proven customer consultation process alongside experienced mentors.
* Travel throughout an assigned territory (typically within a 30-mile radius of the office).

Build the skills needed to take on larger customer portfolios and advance your career.

**Is This a Good Fit for You?**

This role is perfect for people who enjoy working with others, solving problems, and helping businesses make informed decisions. Many of our top performers started in restaurants, retail, hospitality, customer service, athletics, or other customer-facing roles where they learned how to communicate, solve problems, and build relationships. If you’re competitive, coachable, self-motivated, and willing to learn, we’ll provide the training and support to help you succeed.

**Compensation**

**Base Pay + Commission**

* Weekly base pay while you learn the role and build confidence
* Commission earned on new accounts
* Increased earning potential based on performance

**Typical first-year on-target earnings (OTE) range from $55,000–$70,000, with the potential to earn $100,000+ for those who consistently exceed performance goals.**

**Paid Training & Career Development**

Every new hire begins with **paid training and hands-on mentorship**, giving you the opportunity to learn the process, strengthen your product knowledge, and build confidence in your new skills. And the learning doesn’t stop once you’re up and running. As you advance, you’ll have access to continued development in **leadership, business management, and financial skills** designed to prepare you for greater responsibility and opportunity.

Our goal isn’t simply to help you succeed with your first customer—it’s to help you develop the skills to **build a career and continue growing within it**.

**About Universal Energy Solutions**

Universal Energy Solutions helps businesses reduce their energy costs by connecting them with competitive electricity and natural gas supplier programs. **UES Careers** is the recruiting arm of Universal Energy Solutions, supporting hiring across our growing nationwide network of independently owned and operated offices.

 **Requirements**

**Required**

* Valid driver’s license
* Reliable personal vehicle
* Authorized to work in the United States
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills
* Comfortable meeting with business owners face-to-face

**Preferred**

* Previous experience in sales, customer service, retail, hospitality, or another customer-facing role
* Self-motivated with strong communication and organizational skills

  
**Benefits**

**Compensation & Incentives**

* Multiple compensation paths designed to support your career goals
* Paid training
* Commission paid weekly
* Additional performance-based incentives and bonuses

**Career Development**

* Hands-on training from experienced mentors
* Ongoing career coaching
* Career path to Account Manager and leadership positions
* Promote-from-within culture

**Additional Benefits**

* Health benefits after eligibility requirements are met
* Team-oriented work environment

**Personal Executive Assistant & House Manager (Part-Time to Full-Time)**

**Location:** Chicago, IL (North Side) with flexible home-office work **Schedule:** 25 to 30 hours per week, with potential for full-time **Type:** Independent contractor

**About the Role**

We are looking for a resourceful, self-directed Executive Assistant and House Manager to support the professional activities of a commercial real estate executive and a busy family. This is a hybrid role. Roughly half the work is household management, family logistics, and personal administration. The remaining half supports various real estate related activities.

The person who thrives here is entrepreneurial. You see what needs doing before being asked. You are comfortable calling a vendor, a title company, a contractor, or a customer service line and staying on the phone until you have a real answer. You do not wait for a perfect set of instructions. You take a partial brief, figure out the rest, and come back with the problem solved and a short summary of how you solved it.

If you like variety and take satisfaction in being the person who keeps everything moving, this role will fit.

**Household Operations**

· Oversee day-to-day household running and keep common areas organized

· Potentially plan simple, healthy meals around family preferences and schedules

· Manage grocery lists, shopping, and pantry and fridge inventory

· Occasionally family laundry and general household upkeep

· Manage household purchases and online orders

**Family Coordination**

**Personal Administration and Bookkeeping**

· Organize receipts and documentation for accountant handoff

**Travel**

**Real Estate and Property Support**

· Property management experience is a strong plus, not a requirement

**Business Development Support**

· Execute outreach and follow-up campaigns as directed

· Track responses, report results, and flag what is working

**What Makes Someone Successful Here**

· **Multi-tasking.** You can hold several projects and deadlines at once without dropping threads.

· **Discretion.** You will have access to family, financial, and confidential business information. Impeccable integrity is non-negotiable.

· **Follow-through.** Tasks get finished, and the person who assigned them knows they were finished.

**Qualifications**

**Details**

Complete and accurate submissions, clear stakeholder communication, current approval records and timely sign-offs that support MGA’s product launches and marketing activity.

Pay range: $38.19 - $61.45 an hour

Required:

* Bachelor's degree in related area and/or equivalent combination of education and experience.

* Ability to effectively communicate to and interact with patients in a compassionate and kind manner.
* Ability to set priorities and complete ongoing tasks with competing deadlines, with frequent interruptions, to meet the programmatic and department needs, while complying with applicable University policies and federal and state regulations.

**Territory Sales Representative**  
**(1099)**

Small & Medium-Sized Business Sales + Multi-Dwelling Units (Internet services)

  

About WeLink

WeLink is a next-generation wireless internet service provider using advanced millimeter wave technology, including our own custom radios, and a proprietary approach to network deployment. Our technology allows us to deliver fast, reliable, fiber-like internet while expanding into markets more quickly and cost-effectively than traditional providers.

Founded by experienced fixed-wireless professionals, WeLink is building an alternative to traditional cable and telecom providers. We are focused on providing businesses and communities with better connectivity, competitive pricing, and a customer experience they can rely on.

Position Overview

We are looking for a motivated Territory Sales Representative to help grow WeLink's small and medium-sized business customer base.

In this role, you will take ownership of assigned leads and be responsible for executing on new business opportunities, developing relationships with local businesses, and growing WeLink's presence within the market. You will spend much of your time in the field meeting business owners, managers, and decision-makers, understanding their connectivity needs, and introducing them to WeLink's business internet solutions.

This is an opportunity for someone who enjoys building a territory, opening new accounts, and creating business where it didn't exist before. As WeLink expands its SMB division, your work will play an important role in establishing new markets and driving long-term growth.

Key Responsibilities

* Take ownership of an assigned geographic territory and develop a strategy for growing SMB sales.
* Identify businesses and commercial areas that represent new sales opportunities.
* Build a consistent pipeline of potential new customers
* Establish WeLink's presence within new markets by developing relationships with local businesses and decision-makers.

* Meet directly with business owners, managers, and other decision-makers to understand their internet and connectivity needs.
* Introduce WeLink's business internet solutions and explain the value and benefits of switching providers.
* Conduct sales presentations, answer questions, overcome objections, and close new accounts.

* Work with sales leadership and internal teams to develop effective approaches for entering and growing new markets.

* Coordinate with internal teams to help ensure a smooth transition from sale through installation and activation.
* Maintain positive relationships with customers and represent WeLink professionally within the business community.
* Identify opportunities for additional services, referrals, or future business growth.

Qualifications & Skills

* 2+ years previous experience in outside sales, B2B sales, business development, telecommunications, or a related field preferred.
* Comfortable approaching businesses and starting conversations with owners and decision-makers.
* Strong communication, presentation, negotiation, and closing skills.
* Self-motivated and able to work independently in a field-based environment.
* Strong organizational and time-management skills.
* Ability to learn technical products and clearly explain them to customers.
* Valid driver's license and reliable transportation.
* High school diploma or equivalent.

Pay and Perks:

* 6 figure earning potential
* Paid Training: $110/day for up to 5 days.
* Monthly stipend of $2,000 for first 90-days to get you through the ramp period
* Uncapped commissions, paid out weekly
* Flexible Schedule: Work whatever days/hours make sense for you
* Quick sales cycle

*We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity in our workforce. We encourage applications from all qualified individuals, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, age, or any other status protected by applicable law.*

Your focus will be on renewal execution, retention health, and relationship management, ensuring customer success and contract continuity year over year. This position emphasizes consistent renewal performance, operational excellence, and customer advocacy.

  

**What You'll Do as a Renewal Account Manager**

*Renewal and Retention Execution*

* Own the full renewal lifecycle for assigned mid-market accounts
* Drive proactive portfolio management to ensure high renewal rates
* Coordinate and execute 120-day renewal engagement plans to mitigate risk of churn
* Negotiate terms and timing with customer contacts and stakeholders

*Customer Relationship Management*

* Deepen relationships with key stakeholders to ensure consistent value realization and product adoption
* Act as a trusted advisor to customers on product utilization, goals, and outcomes
* Connect with Customer Success and Support internally to solve customer challenges

*Performance and Metrics*

  

* Deliver against **Gross Revenue Retention (GRR)** and **Net Revenue Retention (NRR)** targets

  + Example targets: 90%-95% GRR and 102%-105% NRR annually
* Keep renewal forecasts and pipeline accurate and up to date
* Analyze churn drivers and surface insights for cross-team improvement

*Collaboration*

  

* Partner with Sales, Customer Success, Product, and RevOps to align strategy and customer outcomes
* Facilitate handoffs to senior account managers and support expansion opportunities
* Drive internal communication on risk indicators and renewal planning
* Surface customer feedback to our Product and Services teams, shaping what we build and deliver

**What You Need** **to Do the Job**

*Experience and Skills*

* 3-5 years in SaaS account management, renewals, or customer success
* Strong relationship-building skills and negotiation experience
* Familiarity with CRM tools (e.g., HubSpot, Salesforce) and renewal tracking processes
* Confidence working with mid-market customers, multiple stakeholders, and cross-functional teams
* Experience coordinating with procurement and legal teams to navigate renewals and approvals
* Fluency with and frequent use of modern AI tools and practices

*Mindsets and Traits*

* Customer-centric and proactive, anticipating needs before problems arise
* Organized, analytical, and metrics-driven
* Skilled at guiding timing and value conversations with clarity

**The Nitty-Gritty**

* Compensation: $90k-$100k annually (not commission-based)
* This is a full-time, hybrid position
* Candidate must live within commuting distance of HQ office (Mission Viejo, California)
* Candidate must be willing and able to travel up to 10%
* Sorry, recruiters: We're not open to working with you on this role
* We require a satisfactory background check following offer acceptance

**More About Us**

We're an innovative tech company, and we're always evolving. Our weird and wonderful work culture is unified by geeking out hard over tech: the old, the new, and the yet-to-exist. We value adaptability over perfectionism and productivity over long hours. Also, towels. They're very important to us.

**You'll Fit Right In If**

* You *love* emerging tech: using it, talking about it, tinkering with it
* You're obsessed with using AI to amplify your productivity
* You're not afraid to ask (or answer) *stupid* questions
* You're a strong communicator but your an even better listener
* You were triggered by the grammar in that last bullet
* Your coworkers speak highly of you and your work
* You know your biggest weakness, and it isn't that you're a perfectionist
* You're a builder with a track record to prove it
* You're willing to admit when you screw up (it happens to the best of us)
* You know the answer to the Ultimate Question

**The Typical Perks You'd Expect**

* Medical + FSA
* Voluntary Dental + Vision
* 3 weeks of PTO annually ✈️ (plus more the longer you're with the company)
* 401(k) matching
Other voluntary insurance: life, disability, pet, etc.* ️

**Plus a Few Pleasant Surprises**

* We pay for your phone (unlimited data!)
* We pay for your home internet (unlimited cat videos!)
* $1,000 budget to turn your at-home workspace into a temple of productivity
* Raise and bonus opportunities every year (treat yo self )
* Stock options
* Discounts on fitness, electronics, entertainment, and more
* IRL team-building events and parties in sunny Southern California

**Description**

  
  
  
**At Xe, we live currencies**. Founded in 1993, Xe is a global leader in currency exchange and international money transfers. What began as a simple currency converter has grown into a platform trusted by over 300 million people each year. We provide a comprehensive range of currency services and products, including our real-time exchange rates, Currency Converter, Market Analysis, Currency Data API, supporting 130+ currencies across 190+ countries with quick, easy, secure Money Transfers for individuals and businesses. We leverage technology to deliver these services through our website, mobile app, and by phone. Backed by Euronet, we process more than $115 billion in global payments annually. Xe is profitable, product-led, and focused on building reliable, user-first tools that make moving money across borders easier for everyone.  
  
**Our Principles**  
At Xe, we value people who take initiative, think big, and follow through. We’re curious by nature and not afraid to ask what if or try something new. Everyone’s voice matters here. We expect people to speak up, bring ideas, and take ownership of their work. We don’t micromanage. We trust each other to make good calls, take responsibility, and move fast when it counts. And we care about community. Not in a vague corporate way, but in the sense that we have each other’s backs, stay open to feedback, and build a culture of trust and real collaboration.

* **Ambition****.** We dream big, try things out, and always ask “why not?” and “what if?” We’re ambitious in our thinking and our delivery
* **Responsibility****.** We get involved, bring our perspective, and are always open to new ideas. We take personal responsibility
* **Community.** We value a sense of belonging, trusting each other, and encouraging authenticity. We contribute to our community

  
**The Role****.** The **Sales Development Representative (SDR)** is an early-career opportunity focused on generating early-stage demand and introducing potential corporate clients to Xe’s FX and international payments solutions. You will receive structured training, ongoing mentorship, and a clear development pathway designed to build your confidence and expertise. Using a suite of platforms to effectively manage pipeline growth and outbound channels, you will be well-equipped to target new potential clients. You’ll learn how global businesses manage currency exposure, understand how our products deliver value, and develop the commercial skills needed to succeed in a fast-paced corporate environment.  
  
**Your Mission****.** AsSales Development Representative, you will create consistent, qualified demand by engaging potential corporate clients and identifying ready meeting opportunities for the sales pipeline.

* Execute outbound prospecting across phone, email and digital channels.
* Act as the first point of contact for potential corporate clients.
* Conduct basic qualifications to confirm suitability.
* Build foundational knowledge of FX and international payments.
* Partner with senior SDRs, BDMs and Marketing to progress opportunities.

* Strong communication skills and a proactive mindset.
* Coachability and willingness to learn.
* Interest in sales, financial services or a commercial career.
* Strong organization and time management.
* **Must be located near our Irvine office and be able to work a hybrid onsite schedule four days per week (M-Th).**

  
**How Success Is Measured**

* Quality and consistency of outbound activity.
* Accepted meetings booked.
* Progression in discovery and qualification capability.

* Competitive salary + performance-based commission and incentives.
* 3 weeks paid vacation + personal days + sick time + holidays.
* Health, dental, vision and life insurance.
* 401(k) retirement plan with company match.
* Employee Stock Purchase Plan.
* Global Language Program offering language learning opportunities.
* Wellness initiatives supporting physical, mental, and financial well-being.
* Learning, development, and tuition assistance programs.
* Global career opportunities in an inclusive, mission-driven culture.

  
  
**Why Join Us?** You'll be part of a fast-moving team where your contributions directly impact growth. We invest in our people with tools, mentorship, and opportunities to level up fast-whether that's moving into closing roles or leadership paths. You'll also play a key role in shaping how we go to market in the competitive payments space, using real insights and industry benchmarks to stay ahead of the curve.

new_jobs.description:
UDR, Inc. and its affiliated companies are seeking a **Project Coordinator** to join our team at 399 Fremont, our exclusive 447-home apartment community located in San Francisco, CA. This is a **10–12 month contract role** running through the completion of our building's re-pipe project.

**Schedule:** Monday – Friday, 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM

**Pay Range:** $34.00 - $36.00/hr (Dependent on experience)

**Role Summary**

The **Project Coordinator** assists in managing all aspects of the building's re-pipe project. Key responsibilities include handling **resident communications**, coordinating **schedules**, providing **contractor oversight**, facilitating **inspections**, and managing **quality assurance/quality control (QA/QC) supervision**.

**Essential Functions**

* **Serve as the primary point of contact to promptly address and resolve resident inquiries, concerns, and complaints** **tied to the re-pipe project.**

**Administration, Quality Control & Documentation**

* **Maintain detailed construction records**, including comprehensive progress reports and before-and-after photographs.
* **Track and coordinate post-completion punch-list work** to ensure quality control.
* **Oversee on-site administration** to guarantee proper record-keeping for future liability and warranty purposes.
* **Perform additional project-related duties** as assigned.

**Required Qualifications:**

* **High School Diploma** or equivalent required.
* **3+ years of experience** in residential property management.
* **Prior experience** with construction coordination, renovation projects, or contractor scheduling is highly preferred.

new_jobs.title: Marketing and Communications Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
Description:

**DEPARTMENT:** Marketing and Communications

**POSITION:** Marketing and Communications Coordinator

**REPORTS TO:** Associate Director of Marketing

**CLASIFICATION:** Annual full-time, non-exempt

**WORK SCHEDULE:** Monday-Friday, some nights and weekends required

**SALARY & BENEFITS:** $26.78 per hour; benefits eligible after 90 days

**Position Overview**

The Marketing and Communications Coordinator keeps Berkeley Rep’s marketing department organized and on schedule, connecting the people, vendors, and deadlines behind every production’s campaign. The Marketing and Communications Coordinator reports to the Associate Director of Marketing and manages departmental administration, including invoices, budget tracking, meetings, and shared inboxes. The position traffics ad materials to media vendors and partners, writes copy for media partners, and supports the printed show programs by gathering bios, headshots, credits, and scheduling Positioning and Editorial meetings.

The Marketing and Communications Coordinator also provides hands-on support for show campaigns, partnerships, and audience surveys and coordinates Berkeley Rep’s social media presence. On content, brand voice, and tone, the Marketing and Communications Coordinator works closely with, and under the guidance of, the Director of Marketing and Audience Services. This position also works closely with the Communications Manager, who provides editorial guidance and proofing, and with the annual Marketing Fellow, who contributes to social media and campaign support.

**Who We Are Looking For**

We are looking for a highly organized, dependable, and curious early-career marketer who loves theatre. You can track a dozen deadlines without dropping one, and you follow up until every item is in. You keep a department’s details in order so your colleagues can focus on the big picture. You write clearly, you’re fluent in social media, and you can put personality into a caption. You’re comfortable working with designers, videographers, vendors, and colleagues across the organization. You want a hands-on role where you’ll learn how every part of a major regional theatre’s marketing comes together.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

***Departmental Administration***

* Process vendor invoices, ensuring timely payment, and record entries in the departmental budget tracking sheet.
* Schedule and attend department meetings, take detailed notes, and distribute notes and action items promptly.
* Check shared departmental inboxes in Outlook and Gmail daily, and make sure actionable messages are answered or forwarded to the right person.
* Traffic ad materials to media vendors and partners, tracking specs and deadlines, and write copy for media partners as needed.

***Printed Program Support***

* Solicit bios and headshots from each show’s cast, creative team, and staff, following up until every submission is in.
* Collect show credits from Production departments.
* Schedule Positioning and Editorial meetings with internal departments and external creative teams and distribute notes and action items promptly.
* Hand off collected materials to the Communications Manager, who manages program production, writing, and proofing.
* Assist the Communications Manager with proofing and gathering approvals as needed.

***Campaign and Show Support***

* Work with the Director of Marketing and Audience Services and the Community Engagement and Partnerships Manager to identify, solicit, and contract social media influencers and outside partners for each show.
* Create an external media kit for each show with the Marketing Fellow, and solicit cross-promotions from local theatre, arts, cultural, and affinity organizations.
* Work with the Communications Manager to create pre- and post-show emails for each show. This includes building the post-show survey in SurveyMonkey and distributing survey dashboards to relevant stakeholders.
* Manage in-person distribution of flyers, posters, and collateral as needed, including participation in the TBA Postcard Distribution Network.

***Social Media Coordination***

* Coordinate Berkeley Rep’s social media channels (currently Meta [Facebook, Instagram, and Threads], TikTok, and LinkedIn) in collaboration with the annual Marketing Fellow, under the guidance of the Director of Marketing and Audience Services on content, brand voice, and tone.
* Maintain the social media calendar in Asana, aligned with production schedules, campaigns, and department priorities.
* Request, brief, track, and review content assets from the Creative team, and create some video and graphic content with Creative’s guidance.
* Develop social copy with the Communications Manager.
* Get approval from the Director of Marketing and Audience Services or a designee before posting to Berkeley Rep’s main channels, then schedule and post approved content.
* Reply to comments and messages and monitor channels for questions and feedback. Escalate sensitive, negative, or time-critical issues rather than responding on Berkeley Rep’s behalf.
* Report on social media performance using each platform’s native analytics and Hootsuite, identifying what resonates with audiences.

***Other Responsibilities***

* Actively participate in workshops and training, including harassment prevention, bystander intervention, and antiracism, equity, diversity, inclusion, and access initiatives.
* Demonstrate a high degree of coachability and ability to integrate feedback into daily workflows and processes.
* Perform all other duties as assigned.

Requirements:

**Required**

* 1–3 years of experience in marketing, communications, administration, or social media, preferably in the arts or entertainment.
* Exceptional organizational and follow-through skills, with the ability to manage calendars, deadlines, and many concurrent projects.
* Strong writing and proofreading skills, with the ability to write engaging copy in a consistent brand voice.

new_jobs.title: Recruiting Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
Description:

**Recruitment Coordinator**

**Location –** Palo Alto, CA (Hybrid – on-site as needed for candidate interviews; remote on other days). This role will be 30-40 hours per week with benefits.

**About GondolaBio**

GondolaBio is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on developing breakthrough therapeutics for genetic diseases. GondolaBio is an independent sister company to BridgeBio, originally carved out in 2024 after securing $300M in private financing from external investors. GondolaBio aims to leverage cutting-edge biological research to discover, create, test, and deliver transformative medicines to treat patients who suffer from genetic diseases.

**Position Overview:**

GondolaBio is seeking a detail-oriented and proactive Recruitment Coordinator to join our Talent Acquisition team on a full time basis. In this role, you will serve as a critical partner to recruiters and hiring managers, ensuring a seamless and positive experience for every candidate throughout the interview process. You will be responsible for coordinating both remote and on-site interviews, managing logistics for domestic and international candidates, and maintaining data integrity within our Applicant Tracking System.

**Responsibilities**

* Schedule and coordinate remote video interviews and on-site interviews, ensuring a smooth and professional experience for all candidates
* Be present on-site during candidate interview days to oversee logistics, greet candidates, and ensure the day runs seamlessly from start to finish
* Serve as the primary point of contact for candidates during the interview process, acting as a hospitality-focused ambassador for the GondolaBio brand
* Manage all logistics for on-site candidate visits, including creating detailed interview schedules, securing conference rooms, and arranging domestic and international travel
* Collect and track candidate NDAs prior to on-site visits
* Partner closely with recruiters and hiring managers to move candidates efficiently through each stage of the interview process, including interview scheduling, feedback collection, and reference coordination
* Utilize our Applicant Tracking System (ATS) to document and log all candidate activity, including updating job postings, uploading resumes, advancing interview stages, adding notes, and requesting feedback to maintain data integrity
* Proactively communicate scheduling updates and logistics details to all interview participants
* Identify and implement process improvements to enhance the candidate experience and team efficiency

Requirements:

**Qualifications**

* 1–3 years of experience in a recruiting coordination, administrative, or executive support role; experience in a biotech or life sciences environment a plus
* Proficiency with an ATS strongly preferred
* Experience coordinating complex interview schedules across multiple time zones, including international candidates
* Exceptionally detail-oriented and thorough — someone who catches what others miss and takes ownership of every logistical detail
* Thrives in a fast-paced environment and can manage shifting priorities without losing accuracy or composure
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with a candidate-first mindset
* Ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously across a dynamic, ever-evolving organization
* Comfortable working both independently in a remote setting and on-site when candidate visits require your presence
* Familiarity with video conferencing platforms (Zoom, Teams)

**No** **matter** **your role at** **GondolaBio, successful team members are**

* **Patient Champions** who put patients first, uphold strict ethical standards, and anchor decisions in clinical and scientific integrity.
* **Entrepreneurial Operators** who take ownership and drive toward practical solutions, while exercising sound judgment, respecting established processes, and aligning with teammates and leadership.
* **Truth Seekers** who are rigorous, detail-oriented, and intellectually honest—comfortable challenging assumptions, engaging with data, and updating their views based on evidence.
* **Collaborative Thinkers** who work effectively in data-driven, interdisciplinary environments; listen actively; and welcome questions, debate, and constructive challenge as essential to better decision-making.
* **Individuals Who Inspire Excellence** in themselves and those around them.
* **High-quality Executors** who deliver against goals and milestones with precision, accountability, and appropriate urgency—without compromising scientific rigor or team alignment.

**What We Offer**

* Patient Days, where we are fortunate to hear directly from individuals living with the conditions we are seeking to impact throughout the year and learn how we can improve our efforts
* A culture inspired by our values: put patients first, think independently, be radically transparent, every minute counts, and let the science speak
* An unyielding commitment to always putting patients first
* A de-centralized model that enables our program teams to focus on advancing science and helping patients. Our affiliate structure is designed to eliminate bureaucracy and put decision-making power in the hands of those closest to the science
* A place where you own the vision – both for your program and your own career path
* A collaborative, fast-paced, data-driven environment where we inspire ourselves and each other to always perform at the top of our game
* Access to learning and development resources to help you get in the best professional shape of your life
* Flexible PTO

The base pay range for this position is $70,000 to $80,000 per year. The actual compensation offered will be determined based on a number of job-related factors, including experience, skills, qualifications, and location.

GondolaBio ServiceCo is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex,

new_jobs.description:
**Meet Vestis®:** For the People Who Make It All Work
  
At Vestis®, we provide uniforms, workplace supplies, and professional cleaning that help businesses simplify their workday and keep their teams safe, confident, and focused on what matters most. More than a provider, we are a partner in productivity, trusted to keep you running.
  
Join us and build a career supporting the people who make it all work.
  
  
**Job Overview:**  
The Account Manager (AM) focuses on identifying and developing new product opportunities within the existing customer base. This role involves prospecting, presenting programs, and meeting sales quotas.
  
  
**Responsibilities/Essential Functions:**  

* The AM is expected to penetrate the current customer base and generate revenue through additional category adds – Uniforms, Workplace Supplies, Managed Restroom Services, First Aid and Direct Sales.
* The AM will also focus on securing contract renewals.
* Key responsibilities include documenting customer information, maintaining sales reports, and communicating product details to the service department.
* The AM is responsible for building and maintaining strong relationships with customers to drive sales and identify new opportunities.
* Drive a systematic sampling program that leads to proposal generation.
* As a direct report to the Sales Manager, this position will collaborate with the Sales and Operations teams to sell into the current customer base.

**Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:**  

* Must be customer oriented and able to communicate effectively
* Ability to provide a high quality service within a fast-paced and physically challenging environment
* Goal driven and self-motivated to include problem solving skills
* Knowledgeable in Microsoft Office applications (including Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Internet/Intranet)

**Experience/Qualifications:**  

* High School Diploma or GED required; Bachelor’s/Associates Degree preferred
* Prior experience in Route Sales and/or Business to Business (B2B) sales preferred

**License Requirements/Certifications:**  

* Valid Driver's License required

**Working Environment/Safety Requirements/Physical Requirements:**
  
Safely lift and carry up to 30 lbs consistently
  
  
Headquartered in Roswell, GA, Vestis® is the second largest provider in the industry with over 300,000 customer locations and approximately 20,000 teammates across North America. Vestis® is a leader in the B2B uniform and workplace supplies category. Vestis® provides clean and safe uniform services and workplace supplies to a broad range of North American customers from Fortune 500 companies to locally owned small businesses across a broad set of end markets. The Company’s comprehensive service offering includes a full-service uniform rental program, cleanroom and other specialty garment processing, floor mats, towels, linens, managed restroom services, first aid supplies and more.
  
  
Vestis® is an equal-opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, relation, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or veteran status.
  
  
Equal Opportunity Employer/Protected Veterans/Individuals with Disabilities
  
This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights notice from the Department of Labor.
  
  
Vestis Commitment to Equal Opportunity Employment
  
If you are a job seeker with a disability and require a reasonable accommodation to apply for one of our jobs, you will find the contact information below to request the appropriate accommodation.
  
Reasonable Accommodations and the Online Application Process
  
Consistent with Vestis and Canadian Linen’s commitment to equal employment opportunity, we provide reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities who need assistance in applying electronically for a position with Vestis or Canadian Linen, unless doing so would impose an undue hardship. To request a reasonable accommodation for this purpose, please call 1-833-901-8823 or email us at accessibility@vestis.com.
  
Please note that this phone number is to be used solely to request an accommodation with respect to the online application process. Calls for any other reason will not be returned. Reasonable accommodation requests are considered on a case-by-case basis.
  
Thank you for your interest in an employment opportunity with Vestis, Canadian Linen and Québec Linge.

new_jobs.title: Account Manager
new_jobs.description:
**About Us:**

Proofpoint is a global leader in human- and agent-centric cybersecurity. We protect how people, data, and AI agents connect across email, cloud, and collaboration tools. Over 80 of the Fortune 100, 10,000 large enterprises, and millions of smaller organizations trust Proofpoint to stop threats, prevent data loss, and build resilience across their people and AI workflows. Our mission is simple: safeguard the digital world and empower people to work securely and confidently. Join us in our pursuit to defend data and protect people.

**How We Work:**

At Proofpoint you’ll be part of a global team that breaks barriers to redefine cybersecurity guided by our BRAVE core values:

**Bold** in how we dream and innovate

**Responsive** to feedback, challenges and opportunities

**Accountable** for results and best in class outcomes

**Visionary** in future focused problem-solving

**Exceptional** in execution and impact

We seek an experienced Account Manager to join our growing Commercial Add-On team based out of our Sunnyvale office. In this role you will focus on expanding our product footprint with our existing customer base. By joining our already successful team, you will be an instrumental part of our consistent year over year revenue growth!

Your day-to-day

* This is a Hybrid role requiring you to be in the Sunnyvale office 4 days a week. Monday-Thursday.
* The Account Manager will be responsible for working with our existing customers in a consultative manner to identify additional solutions from the Proofpoint portfolio
* Drive the entire sales process from start to finish including opportunity identification, introductory meetings, product demonstration, customer Q&A, as well as negotiation and closing
* Develop, customize, and utilize effective close plans to navigate and manage the sales process
* Team up with our world class Sales Engineering team to devise and execute account strategies and plans

• Engage with our rapidly expanding channel partner network to educate, inform, and drive incremental revenue • Interact with the management team in 1-1, team meetings and via forecasting and reporting to provide critical updates, and strategic account planning

* Provide outstanding and high touch customer service, including escalation and coordination of support issues as needed
* Become a perpetual student of Proofpoint products, and the ever-changing Cybersecurity industry!
* You can achieve your quota, but quite frankly we would love you to blow it out of the water!
* May require modified work hours to cover accounts in other time zones, and occasional travel for key accounts What you bring to the team
* Minimum 3 years of solution sales experience, focused on generating net new or add-on revenue
* Must have experience selling to the C-suite, extensive experience selling to CISO, CIO, CTO preferred
* Consistent track record of meeting and/or exceeding quota goals
* Experience managing longer sales cycles (2-6 months) from prospecting stage through negotiation and closing
* Experience or training in established sales methodologies such as SPIN, Sandler, Miller Heiman, Value Selling or The Challenger Sale is preferred
* Competitive nature, operating within a team environment
* Ability to present and discuss highly technical information, as well as aptitude to learn new concepts quickly
* Strong presentation skills, both in person and via phone/online
* Security or SaaS sales experience a plus
* Capable of providing great customer care while continuing to identify new revenue opportunities
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience

#LI-JD1

**Why Proofpoint?**

At Proofpoint, we believe that an exceptional career experience includes a comprehensive compensation and benefits package. Here are just a few reasons you’ll love working with us:

* Competitive compensation
* Comprehensive benefits
* Career success on your terms
* Flexible work environment
* Annual wellness and community outreach days
* Always on recognition for your contributions
* Global collaboration and networking opportunities

**Our Culture:**

Our culture is rooted in values that inspire belonging, empower purpose and drive success-every day, for everyone.

We encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. If you need accommodation during the application or interview process, please reach out to accessibility@proofpoint.com.

**How to Apply**

Interested? Submit your application along with any supporting information- we can’t wait to hear from you!

* **Remote – working from home office when not out visiting customers. Must live in Northern California, Oregon, or Washington area to be able to meet onsite with customers. Overnight travel is expected to be 25% up to 50%.**

**“A Day in the Life”**

This is a career opportunity for a highly motivated Sales Professional with a solid work ethic, exceptional character and a dynamic personality. The successful candidate will educate and advise clients on our products and services, work closely with an inside sales partner to grow business, and maintain customer relationships. Working out of your home office, this position requires extensive customer interface at various levels to determine requirements, provide accurate product information and to make sure we do things right the first time, every time.

**“What You’ll Do”**

* Work closely with customers to provide solutions for short to long term testing projects utilizing both operating and capital budgets
* Uncover new business opportunities working with customers and OEM partners
* Follow ethical business practices in compliance with established company policies and procedures
* Participate in sales and product training programs
* Update customer activities and records in the company CRM
* Manage territory to develop/maintain client relationship through the use of telephone, electronic communications and face to face meetings
* Educate and advise clients of TRS-RenTelco on products and services, generating opportunities
* Work effectively with inside sales team partners and support to achieve monthly revenue targets
* Strategic planning of territory activities to implement and execute TRS-RenTelco go-to-market strategy
* Perform other duties as assigned

**“Must Haves”**

* Organized, detailed and accurate with demonstrated high-level computer skills including MS Office tools
* Demonstrated selling and closing skills
* Knowledge of rental and lease practices
* Ability to work independently and from a home office
* Effectively communicate customer requirements to relevant departments within TRS-RenTelco
* BS degree preferred or equivalent experience
* Sales experience calling on customers, prospecting and developing/maintaining relationships for at least 3 or more years
* Technical work or sales experience in electronics and/or micro-computers and services is preferred
* Valid Driver's License

**Special Considerations:**

* Remote position covering all of Northern California, Oregon, Washington, and Idaho.

**“Perks”**

* It’s a great place to work where you are given the space to share ideas and opinions and the bottom-line is “YOU” matter!
* We set you up to win: Commission Bridge support during ramp-up!
* We value our employees' Quality of Life, and when it comes to mental health, recovery, and self-care, there is no one-size-fits-all approach that is why we provide resources where employees can find information on several wellness topics like nutrition, exercise, emotional health, and more!
* We all need to rest and recharge, that’s why in addition to vacation and sick time we also offer 10 days + 2 half days company-paid holidays!
* We offer a variety of benefits that offer you flexibility and choice, a simple selection experience, and the ability to take control over your benefit spending.
* 401(k) Retirement Plan with Company Match.
* Life is unpredictable, having Company Paid Life Insurance and knowing that your loved ones will be protected financially in the event of an unexpected death can give you peace of mind.
* We also offer DailyPay, HSA, FSA, EAP and Pet Insurance!

U.S. Citizenship status is required as this position will involve work with customers where an active U.S. Security Clearance is needed.

This flexibility is a valued part of our culture and supports our commitment to collaboration, agility, and shared success.

McGrath will continue pre-employment drug testing including marijuana, even in states where it is legal, for this position which is classified as safety-sensitive within our construction operations and Drivers. Ensuring a drug-free environment is not only essential for the well-being of our team members but also aligns with regulatory requirements that govern safety-sensitive positions and commercial driving.

**Equal Employment Opportunity & Hiring Requirements**

Pre-employment screenings are conducted after a conditional offer of employment is extended, in accordance with fair hiring laws. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, sex, color, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, on the basis of disability and any other legally protected status. new_jobs.title: Assistant Community Manager
new_jobs.description:
**COMPANY OVERVIEW**

Asset Living is a third-party management firm and a proven partner in fostering thriving communities nationwide. Founded in 1986, Asset Living has decades of experience delivering exceptional value to our partners. Since the beginning, our undeniable passion has driven our organic growth from a small property management firm to one of the most trusted allies in real estate. Asset Living's growing portfolio includes a multitude of properties across the country that span the multifamily, single-family home rentals, affordable housing, build-to-rent, active adult, and student housing divisions.

  

Asset Living is a fast-growing company made up of talented individuals from diverse backgrounds that differentiate us and help us drive innovation and results for our clients and communities across the US. At Asset Living, we wholeheartedly believe 'Together We Lead, Together We Succeed’. We empower each other to lead by example, collaborate, and evolve – inspired by our belief that we can continually improve as individuals and as an organization. Together, we create an environment where every voice is heard, every idea is valued, and every individual experiences opportunities to grow as our company grows. When you join Asset Living, you become part of a dynamic team that thrives on unity, unique talents, and a universal culture of winning.

  

Recognized as one of the nation's Best and Brightest Places to Work and ranked in the NMHC top 50 professionals, join Asset Living because of its reputation as the most trusted partner in real estate, workplace culture, and growth opportunities. Asset Living is a member of The Institute of Real Estate Management (IREM) and is recognized as an Accredited Management Organization (AMO). Together, we lead the way, and together, we achieve excellence in all that we do. Join a workplace where success is a collective journey and leadership is a shared responsibility.

**ASSISTANT COMMUNITY MANAGER**

The Assistant Community Manager is responsible for overseeing, under the supervision of the Community Manager, the everyday operations and financial functions of the housing community. As the Assistant Community Manager, you will play a vital role in the delinquency and collection of rent to optimize the property's cash flow and financial position. As an Assistant Community Manager, you will manage all phases of the operations, including personnel, leasing, maintenance, financial, administration & risk management in the absence of the Community Manager. As an onsite leader, you will supervise all aspects of the property and staff to ensure compliance with the company's policies and procedures, safety and fair housing guidelines, and liability concerns.

**Essential Duties & Responsibilities**

Financial Management

* Responsible for posting all payments and income received from all applicants, current residents, and non-current residents accurately, timely, and efficiently.
* Responsible for processing and reconciling daily all account receivables.
* Monitor and follow up on bad debt to include preparation of late notices, resident and guarantor contact, and filing evictions.
* Responsible for helping the property meet budgeted revenues, expenses, and Net Operating Income.
* Responsible for posting of all charges to resident and non-current resident accounts; to also include bill back of utilities where applicable.
* Responsible for all end-of-the-month closing procedures and reporting.
* Maintain accurate and organized records; audit resident files to ensure accurate records.
* Responsible for walking units and posting all move-out charges, statements, and security deposit refunds.

Personnel Management

* Regular/daily onsite attendance is required
* Use consistent techniques & company directives to screen, hire, train, coach, and develop onsite staff.
* Ensure the effectiveness of staff through ongoing training, coaching, counseling, and guidance in compliance with Asset training benchmarks.
* Promote harmony and quality job performance of staff through support and effective leadership.
* Ensure staff compliance and consistency with Company policies and procedures.
* Strategic Leasing Management
* Ensure staff leasing techniques are effective in obtaining closure, follow-up procedures met, signing/documentation of leases, and reporting systems are accurate and up to date.
* Implement marketing strategies & systems put in place by the annual marketing plan.
* Deal with resident complaints, concerns, and requests to ensure resident satisfaction.
* Develop and implement resident retention programs (i.e., resident functions, special promotions, monthly newsletter, etc.)
* Effectively show, lease, and move in prospective residents.

Administrative Management

* Manage excellent customer service and monitor service request turnaround and responsiveness of maintenance staff.
* Maintain property appearance and ensure repairs are noted and completed on a timely basis (this requires regular property inspections and tours)
* Assist with supervision of all business functions related to operations.
* Plan for and utilize property resources, equipment, and supplies economically (i.e., obtaining bids/pricing from vendors, suppliers, contractors, dealing with inadequate service, etc.)

**Education/Experience**

* High School Diploma or Equivalent; Bachelor’s degree preferred or two years experience in the housing industry; or one to two years related experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Ability to understand and perform all onsite software functions; basic computer skills required.
* Must have basic knowledge of Fair Housing Laws and OSHA requirements.

**Physical Requirements**

* While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to remain in a stationary position, often standing or sitting for prolonged periods, communicate with others to exchange information, repeat motions that m

new_jobs.title: Customer Success Manager, Spanish & English
new_jobs.description:
Overview:

Atlassian is looking for a **Customer Success Manager with Spanish Language proficiency.**

Atlassian Customer Success Managers (CSMs) help customers realize the value in their Atlassian investment. They engage customers to align on strategic goals and unlock early and sustained outcomes by delivering standard methodologies at scale that support product adoption, solution expansion, and long-term growth of customer users.

As an Atlassian CSM, you’ll build relationships and demonstrate an understanding of the Atlassian customer journey and how our solutions help customer achieve their goals. You’ll be equipped to guide complex customers over their hurdles, delivering value realization through proactive and programmatic customer engagement and best practices.

You'll use your solution expertise and leadership presence to cut across multiple products and solution practice areas. You’ll work with a variety of customer profiles including executives, administrators and multi-layered global teams to support the successful adoption and expansion of their Atlassian solution investment.

To help our teams work together, you will be fully remote, and requires you to work the multiple Americas timezones.

Responsibilities:

* Develop a trusted advisor relationship with customers from C-Suite, to executives and global teams helping them succeed with our platform and ensuring they receive maximum value from our solution throughout their lifecycle.
* Experience with SaaS business models and enterprise customer needs resulting in quantifiable outcomes.
* Collaborate with the customer and account team members to develop Customer Success Plans, including regular check-ins, EBRs (Executive Business Reviews), and strategic planning sessions. The account team includes the account executive, solution partners, and other Atlassians.
* Manage post-sales activity for your customers through relationship-building, product expertise and execution.
* Maintain an understanding of our products and solutions and speak with customers about the most relevant features for their specific requirements.
* Engage with your customers to unlock early and sustained product adoption and success with Atlassian Solutions.
* Mitigate churn through early risk identification, intervention, escalation and mitigation in partnership with your seasoned account team and in particular the Account Associate.
* Be the Voice of the Customer to provide internal feedback on how Atlassian can better serve our enterprise customers.
* Fluency in English and Spanish to conduct business, provide guidance, and solicit feedback for customers in Spanish-speaking Latin America countries as well as the United States.

Pay Ranges:

In The **United States**, we have three geographic pay zones. For this role, our current base pay ranges for new hires in each zone are:

**Zone A**: $118,957 - $155,304

**Zone B**: $107,100 - $139,825

**Zone C**: $98,734 - $128,903

new_jobs.title: Business Development Representative – Home Care (Bilingual English/Spanish)
new_jobs.description:
### **Company Description**

Special Touch Home Care is seeking a bilingual business development professional with an outgoing personality, a talent for building relationships, and a passion for connecting people with the care they need.

For 40 years, our licensed home care services agency (LHCSA) has proudly served more than 100,000 clients throughout New York City's five boroughs and Westchester County. Our success is built on compassionate care, dependable service, and the dedicated people who make it possible.

If you enjoy meeting new people, getting involved in the community, and seeing your efforts make a difference, we'd love to have you on our team.

### **Job Description**

As our Business Development Representative, you will help expand our reach by promoting our services to potential clients, healthcare professionals, and community organizations.

This role is primarily office-based, with outreach and attendance at local events and meetings on occasion. You will ensure office visitors receive welcoming, professional customer service while building relationships with businesses and referral sources to generate new client opportunities. You will represent Special Touch Home Care in the community and work closely with our intake team to connect prospective clients with our services.

### **Responsibilities**

* Manage the local office and ensure all visitors receive attentive, professional service.
* Develop and implement marketing and outreach strategies to generate leads and increase client referrals.
* Build and maintain relationships with healthcare professionals, hospitals, rehabilitation centers, assisted living facilities, local businesses, and other referral sources.
* Participate in networking events, health fairs, and community presentations to raise awareness of our services.
* Conduct outreach to potential clients and follow up on new opportunities.
* Collaborate with our community intake team to facilitate the intake process for new clients.
* Educate healthcare professionals and community members about our services and how to make referrals.
* Track outreach activity, leads, and referrals to evaluate results and improve strategies.
* Stay informed about industry trends, competitor activities, and community needs to identify opportunities for growth.

### **Qualifications**

* Associate's degree or higher required.
* Fluency in English and Spanish required.
* Minimum of 2 years of business development experience required, with a demonstrated track record of generating leads, building relationships, and driving business growth.
* Healthcare business dev experience preferred, but not required.
* An outgoing personality and strong interpersonal skills, with the ability to build relationships with people from diverse backgrounds.
* Excellent verbal communication, writing, and presentation skills.
* A self-motivated, results-oriented approach and a passion for making a positive impact.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong organizational and follow-up skills.
* Proficiency in Google Workspace is a plus.

### **Schedule**

Full-time, Monday–Friday, 9 AM–5 PM, with occasional hours outside this schedule based on department needs.

### **Compensation**

$50,000–$85,000 annually, based on experience and its relevance to the role and our company's needs, plus commissions.

**YES, there's room for growth!**

### **Benefits**

* Competitive salary plus commissions.
* Comprehensive benefits package, including health insurance and paid time off.
* Opportunities for growth—we frequently promote from within the company.

* Maintain ongoing contact with State licensing agencies, state and Federal stakeholders as needed.
* Act as Program Subject Matter Expert (SME) in matters related to licensing/ recruiting, bed capacity. Responsible for updating the cross functional team, including the Intake Team, of bed availability and completing reports/logs.
* Upload, maintain and update all foster parent information and home records in Evolve Program: keeping, maintaining, organizing physical files for audits.
* Participate as representative of the Program in state file audits as required.
* Other duties are requested.
* Perform all work in a manner consistent with the National Youth Advocate Program’s mission, values, and philosophies.

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor’s degree in social work or comparable Human Services field from an accredited institution.
* Two (2) years of work experience working in direct service with minors and families strongly preferred.
* Proficient use of desktop and laptop computers, smartphones and tablets, printers, fax machines, and photocopiers, as well as software including word processing, spreadsheet, and database programs.
* Bilingual (English/Spanish). Fluency in Spanish is required.
* Minimum automobile insurance coverage of $100,000/300,000 bodily liability coverage.
* 21 years of age, valid state driver’s license, reliable personal vehicle and a good driving record.

**OTHER SKILLS**

**PHYSICAL DEMANDS**

* Manage registration lists and ensure accurate, up-to-date attendee records throughout the pre-event cycle

  + Build and maintain event websites where applicable
  + Create and manage registration pages in **Cvent**

  + Create and deploy all necessary UTMs, web links, and landing pages as needed

* Manage day-to-day vendor communication to ensure deliverables are on time and meet expectations
* Escalate issues to the Field Marketing Manager as needed
* Track and process vendor invoices to ensure timely payment

### **Attendee Communications**

* Draft and deploy all transactional attendee communications in partnership with the Field Marketing Manager, including:

  + Know Before You Go (KBYG)
  + Event updates and logistics changes
  + Post-event surveys
* Ensure every attendee has the information they need to show up prepared and engaged

### **Post-Event Follow-Up**

* Execute post-event email cadences to support conversion efforts
* Ensure all attendee and response data is accurately logged in Salesforce for pipeline tracking
* Secure survey responses and share this information with the broader leadership team for consideration and analysis

### **What We're Looking For**

* Highly organized with strong attention to detail; you will catch things before they become problems
* Proven ability to run multi-touch outreach campaigns that drive real response rates, not just sends

* Thrive in a fast-paced environment managing multiple events simultaneously
* Prior experience in event coordination, marketing operations, or inside sales outreach preferred

new_jobs.title: Personal Executive Assistant & House Manager
new_jobs.description:
**Personal Executive Assistant & House Manager (Part-Time to Full-Time)**

**Location:** Chicago, IL (North Side) with flexible home-office work **Schedule:** 25 to 30 hours per week, with potential for full-time **Type:** Independent contractor

**About the Role**

We are looking for a resourceful, self-directed Executive Assistant and House Manager to support the professional activities of a commercial real estate executive and a busy family. This is a hybrid role. Roughly half the work is household management, family logistics, and personal administration. The remaining half supports various real estate related activities.

The person who thrives here is entrepreneurial. You see what needs doing before being asked. You are comfortable calling a vendor, a title company, a contractor, or a customer service line and staying on the phone until you have a real answer. You do not wait for a perfect set of instructions. You take a partial brief, figure out the rest, and come back with the problem solved and a short summary of how you solved it.

If you like variety and take satisfaction in being the person who keeps everything moving, this role will fit.

**Household Operations**

· Oversee day-to-day household running and keep common areas organized

· Potentially plan simple, healthy meals around family preferences and schedules

· Manage grocery lists, shopping, and pantry and fridge inventory

· Occasionally family laundry and general household upkeep

· Manage household purchases and online orders

**Family Coordination**

· Coordinate cleaners, babysitters, and other household help, including scheduling and follow-up

· Manage kids' activity schedules, appointments, and related logistics

· Occasionally serve as the point of contact for service providers, activity organizers

· Run local errands (post office, returns, dry cleaning, pharmacy, and similar)

**Personal Administration and Bookkeeping**

· Pay household and property bills and track due dates

· Maintain basic bookkeeping records, categorize expenses, and reconcile statements

· Organize receipts and documentation for accountant handoff

· Manage shared calendars across family and professional commitments

**Travel**

· Plan and book flights, hotels, and ground transportation

· Build itineraries and packing lists, handle pre-trip preparation

· Resolve changes and disruptions in real time

**Real Estate and Property Support**

· Coordinate maintenance, repairs, and vendor scheduling for personal properties

· Track leases, renewals, insurance, and property-related paperwork (leveraging existing software)

· Communicate with tenants, property managers, and service providers as needed

· Property management experience is a strong plus, not a requirement

**Business Development Support**

· Research and organize data sources to identify prospective clients

· Build and maintain accurate contact records in the CRM (working with an in-place team)

· Execute outreach and follow-up campaigns as directed

· Track responses, report results, and flag what is working

· Proofread and edit correspondence and marketing materials

**What Makes Someone Successful Here**

· **Initiative.** You act on incomplete information and ask sharp questions rather than waiting for direction.

· **Phone confidence.** You would rather call than email when calling gets the answer faster, and you follow up until the loop is closed.

· **Judgment.** You know which decisions are yours to make and which need to be escalated.

· **Multi-tasking.** You can hold several projects and deadlines at once without dropping threads.

· **Discretion.** You will have access to family, financial, and confidential business information. Impeccable integrity is non-negotiable.

· **Follow-through.** Tasks get finished, and the person who assigned them knows they were finished.

**Qualifications**

· 2+ years in a house manager, executive assistant, personal assistant, nanny, or similar support role

· Strong organizational and time-management skills

· Strong written and verbal communication, including proofreading and editing

· Comfort with technology: shared calendars, Microsoft Office or Google Workspace, online ordering, and CRM or database tools

· Basic bookkeeping or bill-pay experience (not required but helpful)

· Real estate license, property management, or commercial real estate exposure is a plus but not required (desire to attain a real estate license is a plus)

· Valid driver's license and reliable transportation

· Bachelor's degree preferred

**Details**

· Approximately 25 to 30+ hours per week, schedule to be agreed upon

· Mix of on-site work and remote administrative work

· Occasional flexibility outside standard hours for time-sensitive items

· References preferred

Pay: $28.00 - $38.00 per hour

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Chicago, IL
